decisions.reason: The meaning decision (footnoted) reads the phrase as praying about himself; Literal keeps the Greek's "toward himself", which can also be read as "to himself".

decisions.choice: ladrões (L); gente trapaceira (B); roubam os outros (R)
decisions.reason: The word is for grasping people who take what belongs to others (m2). "Ladrões" is the plain word at Literal; Balanced says "trapaceira" for people who cheat others of their goods, as the English "swindlers"; "extorsionário" is too technical.

decisions.choice: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ (O God), with the familiar "አንተ" (አመሰግንሃለሁ)
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "እግዚአብሔር" for God and the Bible's familiar address in prayer; the same address opens the tax collector's prayer in 18:13.

decisions.choice: the list of others and "this tax collector" before "I thank you"
decisions.reason: Amharic is verb-final, so the reason clause with "ስላልሆንኩ" comes before "አመሰግንሃለሁ"; Readable keeps the thanks first by splitting the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Боже"
decisions.reason: The vocative "Боже" is still the living Russian way to call on God in prayer, unlike "Отче", which the style guide replaces with "Отец".
People speaking to God say "तू", the intimate address of Hindi prayer, as the style guide has it; the tax collector in 18:13 prays the same way.

decisions.choice: the Pharisee prays in the polite style ("感謝します")
decisions.reason: Both men in the parable address God politely, as people in Japanese pray; the contrast between them lies in what they say, not in their register.

decisions.choice: "自分に向かって" (L); "自分のことを" (B), "自分のことについて" (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean to himself or about himself (m1). Literal keeps the ambiguity; Balanced and Readable say he prayed about himself, as the English does.

source.text: νηστεύω δὶς τοῦ σαββάτου, ἀποδεκατῶ πάντα ὅσα κτῶμαι.

records.literal_gloss: I fast twice in the week, I tithe all things as many as I gain.

en.L: I fast twice in the week; I give a tenth of all that I gain.'
en.B: Twice every week I fast, and I give a tenth of everything I take in.'
en.R: I go without food two days every week. And I give a tenth of all the money I get.'

es.L: Ayuno dos veces en la semana, pago el diezmo de todo cuanto adquiero”.
es.B: Dos veces por semana ayuno, y entrego la décima parte de todo lo que recibo”.
es.R: Dejo de comer dos días cada semana. Y doy la décima parte de todo el dinero que recibo”.

fr.L: Je jeûne deux fois par semaine, je donne la dîme de tout ce que j’acquiers.”
fr.B: Deux fois par semaine, je jeûne, et je donne le dixième de tout ce que je gagne.”
fr.R: Je ne mange rien deux jours par semaine. Et je donne le dixième de tout l’argent que je reçois.”

sw.L: Ninafunga mara mbili kila wiki; natoa zaka ya kila kitu ninachopata.'
sw.B: Kila wiki ninafunga siku mbili, na ninatoa sehemu ya kumi ya kila kitu ninachopokea.'
sw.R: Ninakaa bila kula siku mbili kila wiki. Na ninatoa sehemu ya kumi ya fedha zote ninazopata.'

vi.L: Con kiêng ăn mỗi tuần hai lần, con dâng một phần mười mọi thứ con thu được.'
vi.B: Mỗi tuần con kiêng ăn hai lần, và con dâng một phần mười mọi lợi tức của con.'
vi.R: Mỗi tuần con nhịn ăn hai ngày. Và con dâng một phần mười tất cả số tiền con kiếm được.'

ko.L: 저는 일주일에 두 번 금식하고, 얻는 모든 것의 십일조를 바칩니다.'
ko.B: 저는 일주일에 두 번씩 금식하고, 버는 것은 무엇이든 십일조를 바칩니다.'
ko.R: 저는 일주일에 두 번씩 아무것도 먹지 않고 기도합니다. 그리고 버는 돈은 모두 십분의 일을 하나님께 바칩니다.'

pt.L: Jejuo duas vezes por semana; dou o dízimo de tudo o que ganho.'
pt.B: Jejuo duas vezes por semana e dou a décima parte de tudo o que recebo.'
pt.R: Eu fico sem comer dois dias por semana. E dou a décima parte de todo o dinheiro que ganho.'

am.L: በሳምንት ሁለት ጊዜ እጾማለሁ፤ ከማገኘው ሁሉ አንድ አሥረኛውን እሰጣለሁ።”
am.B: በየሳምንቱ ሁለት ጊዜ እጾማለሁ፤ ከማገኘውም ሁሉ አሥራት አወጣለሁ።”
am.R: በየሳምንቱ ሁለት ቀን ምግብ ሳልበላ እጾማለሁ። ከማገኘውም ገንዘብ ሁሉ አንድ አሥረኛውን እሰጣለሁ።”

ru.L: Пощусь дважды в неделю, даю десятую часть от всего, что приобретаю.”
ru.B: Я пощусь два раза в неделю и отдаю десятую часть всего, что получаю.”
ru.R: Два дня в неделю я ничего не ем. И я отдаю десятую часть всех денег, которые получаю.”

hi.L: मैं सप्ताह में दो बार उपवास करता हूँ; जो कुछ मैं कमाता हूँ उस सब का दसवाँ अंश देता हूँ।'
hi.B: मैं हर सप्ताह दो बार उपवास करता हूँ, और अपनी सारी आमदनी का दसवाँ हिस्सा देता हूँ।'
hi.R: मैं हर सप्ताह दो दिन बिना खाए रहता हूँ। और जो भी पैसा मुझे मिलता है, उसका दसवाँ हिस्सा देता हूँ।'

uk.L: Пощу двічі на тиждень, даю десятину з усього, що набуваю.”
uk.B: Двічі на тиждень я пощу й віддаю десяту частину з усього, що отримую.”
uk.R: Я не їм два дні щотижня. І я віддаю десяту частину всіх грошей, які отримую.”

ja.L: わたしは週に二度断食し、手に入れるものすべての十分の一を献げています。』
ja.B: わたしは毎週二度断食し、収入のすべての十分の一を献げています。』
ja.R: わたしは毎週二日、食事をとらずに祈っています。そして、手に入るお金の十分の一を、みな神にささげています。』

decisions.choice: I fast twice a week: going beyond what the law required
decisions.reason: The law of Moses commanded fasting only on the Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16:29). Devout Jews of the time also fasted twice a week, on Mondays and Thursdays.

decisions.choice: I give a tenth of all I gain: the tithe, on everything, not only what the law named
alternatives: a tenth of his profit only
decisions.reason: The law required a tenth of the crops and herds (Deuteronomy 14:22-23). The Pharisees were careful to tithe even small herbs (11:42). This man tithes all he acquires.

decisions.choice: go without food; all the money I get
decisions.reason: Readable explains fasting and puts "gain" in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "금식하다" (L, B), "아무것도 먹지 않고 기도하다" (R); "십일조" (L, B), "십분의 일" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 11:42 for the tithe.

decisions.choice: አሥራት አወጣለሁ (I give the tithe)
alternatives: አንድ አሥረኛውን እሰጣለሁ (I give a tenth)
decisions.reason: "አሥራት" is the established word for the tithe in Ethiopian church life; Literal and Readable say "a tenth".

decisions.choice: "食事をとらずに祈っています"; "十分の一を……ささげています" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains fasting and tithing in everyday words, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ὁ δὲ τελώνης μακρόθεν ἑστὼς οὐκ ἤθελεν οὐδὲ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἐπᾶραι εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν, ἀλλ’ ἔτυπτε τὸ στῆθος αὐτοῦ λέγων· Ὁ θεός, ἱλάσθητί μοι τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ.

records.literal_gloss: But the tax collector afar off standing not was willing not even the eyes to lift up to heaven, but was striking the breast of himself saying, God, be merciful to me the sinner.

en.L: But the tax collector, standing far off, was not willing even to lift up [his] eyes to heaven, but was striking his breast, saying, 'God, be merciful to me, the sinner.'
en.B: The tax collector, though, kept back at a distance and would not even lift his eyes toward heaven. Instead he struck his chest again and again and said, 'God, be merciful to me, the sinner!'
en.R: But the tax collector stood far away. He did not even look up toward heaven. He kept beating on his chest in sorrow. He said, 'God, be merciful to me. I am a sinner!'

es.L: Pero el publicano, de pie a lo lejos, no quería levantar ni siquiera los ojos hacia el cielo, sino que se daba golpes en el pecho, diciendo: “Dios, ten misericordia de mí, el pecador”.
es.B: El cobrador de impuestos, en cambio, se quedó a distancia y ni siquiera quería levantar la mirada al cielo. Se golpeaba el pecho una y otra vez y decía: “¡Dios, ten misericordia de mí, el pecador!”.
es.R: Pero el cobrador de impuestos se quedó de pie lejos. Ni siquiera miró hacia el cielo. Se golpeaba el pecho una y otra vez, lleno de tristeza. Decía: “Dios, ten compasión de mí. ¡Soy un pecador!”.

fr.L: Mais le collecteur d’impôts, se tenant à distance, ne voulait même pas lever les yeux vers le ciel, mais il se frappait la poitrine, en disant : “Ô Dieu, sois favorable envers moi, le pécheur.”
fr.B: Le collecteur d’impôts, lui, restait à l’écart et n’osait même pas lever les yeux vers le ciel. Au contraire, il se frappait la poitrine encore et encore, et il disait : “Ô Dieu, fais-moi grâce, à moi, le pécheur !”
fr.R: Mais le collecteur d’impôts, lui, est resté loin. Il n’a même pas levé les yeux vers le ciel. Il se frappait la poitrine parce qu’il était triste de son péché. Il disait : “Ô Dieu, aie pitié de moi. Je suis un pécheur !”

sw.L: Lakini yule mtoza ushuru, akiwa amesimama mbali, hakutaka hata kuinua macho [yake] kuelekea mbinguni, bali alikuwa akijipiga kifua chake, akisema, 'Mungu, nihurumie mimi, yule mwenye dhambi.'
sw.B: Lakini yule mtoza ushuru alibaki amesimama kwa mbali, wala hakutaka hata kutazama juu mbinguni. Badala yake aliendelea kujipiga kifua, akisema, 'Mungu, nihurumie mimi, mwenye dhambi!'
sw.R: Lakini yule mtoza ushuru alisimama mbali. Hakutazama hata juu mbinguni. Aliendelea kujipiga kifua kwa huzuni. Akasema, 'Mungu, nihurumie. Mimi ni mwenye dhambi!'

vi.L: Còn người thu thuế đứng đằng xa, ngay cả mắt cũng không muốn ngước lên trời, nhưng cứ đấm ngực mà nói: 'Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin thương xót con, là người tội lỗi.'
vi.B: Nhưng người thu thuế thì đứng xa xa, thậm chí không dám ngước mắt lên trời. Ông cứ đấm ngực và nói: 'Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin thương xót con, là người tội lỗi!'
vi.R: Nhưng người thu thuế đứng ở đằng xa. Ông không dám ngước mắt lên trời. Ông cứ đấm ngực vì buồn rầu và nói: 'Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin thương xót con. Con là người tội lỗi!'

ko.L: 그러나 세리는 멀리 서서 하늘을 향하여 눈을 들려고도 하지 않고, 자기 가슴을 치며 말했다. '하나님, 죄인인 저에게 자비를 베풀어 주십시오.'
ko.B: 그러나 세리는 멀찍이 서서 감히 하늘을 쳐다보지도 못하고, 가슴을 치며 말했다. '하나님, 죄인인 저를 불쌍히 여겨 주십시오!'
ko.R: 그러나 세금 걷는 사람은 멀리 떨어져 서 있었다. 그는 하늘을 올려다보지도 못했다. 그리고 슬퍼하며 자기 가슴을 계속 쳤다. 그가 말했다. '하나님, 저를 불쌍히 여겨 주십시오. 저는 죄인입니다!'

pt.L: Mas o cobrador de impostos, de pé, a distância, não queria nem levantar os olhos ao céu, mas batia no peito, dizendo: 'Ó Deus, sê propício a mim, o pecador.'
pt.B: O cobrador de impostos, porém, ficou de longe e não queria nem levantar os olhos para o céu. Em vez disso, batia no peito sem parar e dizia: 'Ó Deus, tem misericórdia de mim, o pecador!'
pt.R: Mas o cobrador de impostos ficou longe. Ele nem olhava para o céu. Ele batia no peito, cheio de tristeza, e dizia: 'Ó Deus, tem misericórdia de mim. Eu sou um pecador!'

am.L: ቀራጩ ግን በሩቅ ቆሞ ዓይኖቹን ወደ ሰማይ እንኳ ሊያነሣ አልፈለገም፤ ነገር ግን ደረቱን እየደቃ፦ “እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ለእኔ ለኃጢአተኛው ምሕረት አድርግልኝ” ይል ነበር።
am.B: ቀራጩ ግን ራቅ ብሎ ቆመ፤ ዓይኖቹን ወደ ሰማይ እንኳ ማንሣት አልፈለገም። ይልቁንም ደረቱን ደጋግሞ እየደቃ “እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ለእኔ ለኃጢአተኛው ራራልኝ!” አለ።
am.R: ቀራጩ ግን ርቆ ቆመ። ቀና ብሎ ወደ ሰማይ እንኳ አላየም። በሐዘን ደረቱን ይደቃ ነበር። እንዲህም አለ፦ “እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ራራልኝ። እኔ ኃጢአተኛ ነኝ!”

ru.L: А мытарь стоял вдали и не хотел даже поднять глаза к небу, но бил себя в грудь, говоря: “Боже, будь милостив ко мне, грешнику.”
ru.B: А сборщик налогов стоял в стороне и не решался даже поднять глаза к небу. Он снова и снова бил себя в грудь и говорил: “Боже, смилуйся надо мной, грешником!”
ru.R: А сборщик налогов стоял далеко. Он даже не поднимал глаз к небу. Он бил себя в грудь от горя и говорил: “Боже, смилуйся надо мной. Я грешник!”

hi.L: पर महसूल लेनेवाला दूर ही खड़ा रहा; वह अपनी आँखें स्वर्ग की ओर उठाने को भी तैयार न था, पर अपनी छाती पर मारता हुआ कहता रहा, 'हे परमेश्वर, मुझ पापी पर करुणा कर।'
hi.B: पर कर वसूलनेवाला दूर ही खड़ा रहा और स्वर्ग की ओर अपनी आँखें तक न उठाईं। वह बार-बार अपनी छाती पीटता और कहता, 'हे परमेश्वर, मुझ पापी पर दया कर!'
hi.R: पर कर वसूलनेवाला दूर खड़ा रहा। उसने स्वर्ग की ओर ऊपर देखा तक नहीं। वह दुख के मारे अपनी छाती पीटता रहा। उसने कहा, 'हे परमेश्वर, मुझ पर दया कर। मैं पापी हूँ!'

uk.L: А митар, стоячи віддалік, не хотів навіть очей підняти до неба, але бив себе в груди, кажучи: “Боже, змилуйся наді мною, грішником.”
uk.B: А збирач податків стояв віддалік і не смів навіть очей підвести до неба. Він знову й знову бив себе в груди й казав: “Боже, змилуйся наді мною, грішником!”
uk.R: А збирач податків стояв далеко. Він навіть не дивився вгору, до неба. Він бив себе в груди, бо дуже шкодував за свої гріхи. Він казав: “Боже, змилуйся наді мною. Я грішник!”

ja.L: しかし徴税人は遠く離れて立ち、目を天に上げようともせず、胸を打ちながら言っていた。『神よ、罪人であるこのわたしをあわれんでください。』
ja.B: ところが徴税人は遠く離れて立ち、目を天に向けようともしないで、胸を打ちながら言った。『神よ、罪人のわたしをあわれんでください！』
ja.R: でも、税金を集める人は遠く離れて立っていた。天の方を見上げようともしなかった。そして悲しみのあまり、自分の胸をたたき続けながら言った。『神よ、わたしをあわれんでください。わたしは罪人です！』

decisions.choice: be merciful to me: turn your anger away from me and show me mercy
alternatives: have pity on me in general
decisions.reason: This verb is not the usual word for mercy. It is used for God being turned from anger and making peace through the removing of sin (Hebrews 2:17 uses it of atoning for sins). In the temple, at the hour of sacrifice, the man asks God to deal with his sin and accept him.

decisions.choice: the sinner: he sees himself as the sinner, with no one to compare himself to
decisions.reason: The article points to himself alone. Where the Pharisee compared himself with others, the tax collector does not.

decisions.choice: striking his breast: a sign of grief and sorrow for sin
decisions.reason: People beat their chests in deep grief (23:48).

decisions.choice: standing far off, eyes down: shame before God
decisions.reason: People usually prayed standing, looking up toward heaven. He keeps his distance and his eyes down, like Ezra in Ezra 9:6.

decisions.choice: I am a sinner!
decisions.reason: Readable makes the description a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: in sorrow
decisions.reason: Readable says what the gesture meant.

decisions.choice: ten misericordia de mí (L, B); ten compasión de mí (R)
decisions.reason: The verb asks God to turn his anger away and show mercy (meaning decision m1). "Sé propicio" is the older Bible phrase and is not everyday Spanish; "ten misericordia" says the plea plainly, and Readable uses the plainer "compasión".

decisions.choice: nihurumie
decisions.reason: The verb asks God to turn his anger away and show mercy (meaning decision m1). "Kuhurumia" is the everyday word for showing mercy and suits a plea from a broken man; "kuwia radhi" (to pardon) would say less about mercy.

decisions.choice: "xin thương xót con" for "be merciful to me"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision gives both sides of the verb, turning anger away and showing mercy; "thương xót" is the plea a sinner makes, and the footnoted sense is kept in the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "자비를 베풀어 주십시오" (L), "불쌍히 여겨 주십시오" (B, R); "죄인인 저"
decisions.reason: The verb asks God to turn his anger away and show mercy (meaning decision); the article "the sinner" is carried by "죄인인 저", the sinner who is I.

decisions.choice: sê propício (L); tem misericórdia (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is not the usual word for mercy: it speaks of God turning from anger and dealing with sin (m1). Literal keeps that with "sê propício", the "tu" imperative of "ser", formal but correct in prayer; Balanced and Readable use the everyday "tem misericórdia", as the English says "be merciful".

decisions.choice: ለእኔ ለኃጢአተኛው (to me, the sinner, L, B); እኔ ኃጢአተኛ ነኝ (I am a sinner, R)
decisions.reason: The definite "-ው" keeps the Greek "the sinner" (m2); Readable says it as a confession, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "あわれんでください"
decisions.reason: Japanese has no everyday word for being turned from anger to mercy; "あわれんでください" is the plea a reader knows, and the meaning decision (m1) explains how this verb differs from the usual word for mercy.

decisions.choice: "罪人であるこのわたし" (L); "罪人のわたし" (B)
decisions.reason: The article points to himself alone (m2); "この" carries it at Literal.

source.text: λέγω ὑμῖν, κατέβη οὗτος δεδικαιωμένος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ παρ’ ἐκεῖνον· ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὑψῶν ἑαυτὸν ταπεινωθήσεται, ὁ δὲ ταπεινῶν ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: I say to you, went down this one justified to the house of him rather than that one; for everyone exalting himself will be humbled, the [one] however humbling himself will be exalted.

en.L: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than that one. For everyone who exalts {{gender:themselves|himself}} will be humbled, but the one who humbles {{gender:themselves|himself}} will be exalted."
en.B: I tell you, it was this man, not the other, who went home put right with God. For everyone who lifts {{gender:themselves|himself}} up will be brought low, and the one who takes the low place will be lifted up."
en.R: I tell you, when the two men went home, God had accepted the tax collector as right with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, but not the Pharisee. Anyone who puts {{gender:themselves|himself}} above others will be brought down. But anyone who is humble will be lifted up."

es.L: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que este bajó a su casa justificado, y no aquel; porque todo el que se ensalza a sí mismo será humillado, pero el que se humilla a sí mismo será ensalzado».
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que fue este, y no el otro, quien volvió a su casa justificado ante Dios. Porque todo el que se ensalza será rebajado, y el que ocupa el lugar humilde será ensalzado».
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que, cuando los dos hombres volvieron a casa, Dios había aceptado al cobrador de impuestos como justo ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, pero no al fariseo. El que se pone por encima de los demás será rebajado. Pero el que es humilde será levantado».

fr.L: Je vous le dis, celui-ci est descendu dans sa maison justifié, plutôt que celui-là. Car quiconque s’élève sera abaissé, mais celui qui s’abaisse sera élevé. »
fr.B: Je vous le dis, c’est cet homme-ci, et non l’autre, qui est rentré chez lui déclaré juste par Dieu. Car quiconque s’élève lui-même sera abaissé, et celui qui prend la dernière place sera élevé. »
fr.R: Je vous le dis : quand les deux hommes sont rentrés chez eux, Dieu avait mis le collecteur d’impôts en règle avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, mais pas le Pharisien. Celui qui se place au-dessus des autres sera abaissé. Mais celui qui est humble sera élevé. »

sw.L: Nawaambia, huyu alishuka kurudi nyumbani kwake akiwa amehesabiwa haki, si yule mwingine; kwa sababu kila mtu anayejiinua atashushwa, lakini yule anayejishusha atainuliwa."
sw.B: Nawaambia, ni huyu, wala si yule mwingine, aliyerudi nyumbani akiwa amekubaliwa na Mungu kuwa mwenye haki. Kwa maana kila anayejiinua atashushwa chini, na anayejinyenyekeza atainuliwa."
sw.R: Nawaambia, wale watu wawili waliporudi nyumbani, Mungu alikuwa amemkubali yule mtoza ushuru kuwa mwenye haki mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, lakini hakumkubali yule Mfarisayo. Mtu yeyote anayejiweka juu ya wengine atashushwa. Lakini mtu mnyenyekevu atainuliwa."

vi.L: Ta nói với các người, người này trở về nhà mình, được xưng công chính, chứ không phải người kia; vì hễ ai tự tôn mình lên sẽ bị hạ xuống, còn ai tự hạ mình xuống sẽ được tôn lên."
vi.B: Ta nói với các người, chính người này, chứ không phải người kia, đã trở về nhà mình và được Đức Chúa Trời xưng là công chính. Vì ai tự nâng mình lên sẽ bị hạ xuống, còn ai tự hạ mình xuống sẽ được nâng lên."
vi.R: Ta nói với các người, khi hai người ấy về nhà, Đức Chúa Trời đã chấp nhận người thu thuế là người công chính trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, còn người Pha-ri-si thì không. Ai tự đặt mình cao hơn người khác sẽ bị hạ xuống. Nhưng ai khiêm nhường sẽ được nâng lên."

ko.L: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 저 사람이 아니라 이 사람이 의롭다고 인정받고 자기 집으로 내려갔다. 누구든지 자기를 높이는 사람은 낮아지고, 자기를 낮추는 사람은 높아질 것이기 때문이다."
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 하나님께 의롭다고 인정받고 집으로 돌아간 사람은 저 바리새파 사람이 아니라 이 세리였다. 누구든지 자기를 높이는 사람은 낮아지고, 자기를 낮추는 사람은 높아질 것이다."
ko.R: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 두 사람이 집으로 돌아갈 때, 하나님께서는 바리새파 사람이 아니라 세금 걷는 사람을 옳다고 받아 주셨다. 스스로 남보다 높아지려는 사람은 누구나 낮아질 것이다. 그러나 스스로 낮추는 사람은 높아질 것이다."

pt.L: Eu lhes digo: este desceu justificado para a sua casa, em vez daquele; pois todo o que se exalta será humilhado, mas quem se humilha será exaltado."
pt.B: Eu lhes digo: foi este homem, e não o outro, que voltou para casa declarado justo por Deus. Pois todo aquele que se coloca no alto será rebaixado, e quem ocupa o lugar mais baixo será elevado."
pt.R: Eu digo a vocês: quando os dois homens voltaram para casa, Deus tinha aceitado o cobrador de impostos como justo diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, mas não o fariseu. Quem se coloca acima dos outros vai ser rebaixado. Mas quem é humilde vai ser elevado."

am.L: እላችኋለሁ፣ ከዚያኛው ይልቅ ይህ ጸድቆ ወደ ቤቱ ወረደ፤ ራሱን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ይዋረዳልና፤ ራሱን የሚያዋርድ ግን ከፍ ይላል።»
am.B: እላችኋለሁ፣ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቅ ሆኖ ወደ ቤቱ የሄደው ይህ ሰው እንጂ ያኛው አልነበረም። ራሱን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ዝቅ ይደረጋል፤ ራሱን ዝቅ የሚያደርግ ግን ከፍ ይደረጋል።»
am.R: እነግራችኋለሁ፣ ሁለቱ ሰዎች ወደ ቤታቸው በሄዱ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ቀራጩን በፊቱ ትክክል እንደ ሆነ አድርጎ ተቀብሎት ነበር፤ ፈሪሳዊውን ግን አልተቀበለውም። ራሱን ከሌሎች በላይ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ዝቅ ይደረጋል። ትሑት የሆነ ሁሉ ግን ከፍ ይደረጋል።»

ru.L: Говорю вам: этот пошёл в свой дом оправданным, а не тот; потому что всякий, возвышающий себя, будет унижен, а унижающий себя будет возвышен.»
ru.B: Говорю вам: именно этот человек, а не тот, вернулся домой оправданным перед Богом. Ведь каждый, кто превозносит себя, будет унижен, а кто занимает низкое место, будет возвышен.»
ru.R: Говорю вам: когда эти двое пошли домой, Бог принял сборщика налогов как праведного перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, а фарисея — нет. Кто ставит себя выше других, того унизят. А кто смиренный, того возвысят.»

hi.L: मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ, उस दूसरे की अपेक्षा यह धर्मी ठहरकर अपने घर लौटा; क्योंकि हर कोई जो अपने आप को ऊँचा उठाता है, नीचा किया जाएगा, पर जो अपने आप को नीचा करता है, वह ऊँचा उठाया जाएगा।"
hi.B: मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ, दूसरा नहीं, बल्कि यही आदमी परमेश्वर के साथ सही होकर घर गया। क्योंकि जो कोई अपने आप को ऊपर उठाता है, उसे नीचे गिराया जाएगा, और जो नीचा स्थान लेता है, उसे ऊपर उठाया जाएगा।"
hi.R: मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ, जब वे दोनों आदमी घर गए, तो परमेश्वर ने कर वसूलनेवाले को अपनी नज़र में सही मान लिया था, पर फ़रीसी को नहीं। जो कोई अपने आप को दूसरों से ऊपर रखता है, उसे नीचे लाया जाएगा। पर जो नम्र है, उसे ऊपर उठाया जाएगा।"

uk.L: Кажу вам, цей пішов до свого дому виправданим, а не той. Бо кожен, хто підносить себе, буде принижений, а хто принижує себе, буде піднесений.»
uk.B: Кажу вам: саме цей, а не той, повернувся додому виправданим перед Богом. Бо кожен, хто звеличує себе, буде принижений, а хто вибирає найнижче місце, буде піднесений.»
uk.R: Кажу вам: коли ці двоє йшли додому, Бог прийняв збирача податків як праведного перед собою, а фарисея — ні. Хто ставить себе вище за інших, того буде принижено. А хто смиренний, того буде піднесено.»

ja.L: あなたがたに言う。義とされて自分の家に帰ったのは、あの人ではなく、この人である。自分を高くする者はみな低くされ、自分を低くする者は高くされるからである。」
ja.B: あなたがたに言っておく。神に義とされて家に帰ったのは、この人であって、あの人ではない。自分を高くする者はみな低くされ、自分を低くする者は高くされるのである。」
ja.R: 言っておく。二人が家に帰ったとき、神に正しい者と認められていたのは、税金を集める人のほうで、ファリサイ派の人ではなかった。自分をほかの人より上に置く人は、低くされる。でも、へりくだる人は、高くされるのだ。」

decisions.choice: justified: declared right with God, accepted by him
decisions.reason: The verb is used for a judge's ruling that someone is in the right. God accepted the man who confessed his sin, not the one who listed his good deeds (compare Romans 4:5).

decisions.choice: rather than that one: the other was not justified
decisions.reason: The phrase does not mean both were justified to different degrees; it means this one and not the other.

decisions.choice: whoever exalts himself will be humbled: God reverses human rank
decisions.reason: Jesus said the same at a meal (14:11). The passives point to God, who brings down the proud and lifts up the lowly (1:52).

decisions.choice: put right with God (B); God had accepted ... as right with him (R)
decisions.reason: "Justified" is church language. Balanced and Readable say what it means; Literal keeps the word.

decisions.choice: brought low ... lifted up (B); brought down ... lifted up (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the picture of going down and up.

decisions.choice: se ensalza ... se humilla, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has {{gender:themselves|himself}}. The Spanish reflexive "se" serves for a man or a woman, so there is no second wording for the setting to choose; "todo el que" is the ordinary Spanish for "everyone who".

decisions.choice: justifié (L); déclaré juste par Dieu (B); Dieu l’avait mis en règle avec lui (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's terms for justify. Literal keeps the word; Balanced says what it means, adding "par Dieu" as the English Balanced says "with God"; Readable follows the English "right with him" (m1).

decisions.choice: quiconque s’élève; celui qui s’abaisse, with no gender span
alternatives: a gender setting on the reflexive
decisions.reason: The French reflexive "se" does not mark sex, and "quiconque" and "celui qui" already mean anyone, so French needs no setting where the English has "themselves / himself".

decisions.choice: amehesabiwa haki (L); amekubaliwa na Mungu kuwa mwenye haki (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means declared right with God and accepted by him (meaning decision m1). Literal uses the standard phrase "kuhesabiwa haki"; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "được xưng công chính" (L); "được Đức Chúa Trời xưng là công chính" (B); "Đức Chúa Trời đã chấp nhận ... là người công chính" (R)
decisions.reason: Declared right with God (meaning decision); the words echo "công chính" in 18:9. The saying at the end keeps the wording of Luke 14:11, and "mình" needs no gender span.

decisions.choice: "các người" for those Jesus is speaking to
decisions.reason: The parable is told to those who trusted in their own righteousness (18:9), not to the disciples.

decisions.choice: "의롭다고 인정받다" (L, B); "하나님께서 옳다고 받아 주시다" (R)
decisions.reason: Justified is declared right with God and accepted by him (meaning decision); the closing saying is worded as the Korean Luke 14:11.

decisions.choice: "자기" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "자기" serves for men and women alike, as in the Korean Luke 14:11.

decisions.choice: justificado (L); declarado justo por Deus (B); Deus tinha aceitado ... como justo (R)
decisions.reason: As docs/portuguese-style.md, section 6: "justificar" at Literal, "declarar justo" at Balanced, which keeps the judge's ruling of m1; Readable says God accepted him, as the English Readable does (see 18:9).

decisions.choice: todo o que se exalta ... quem se humilha, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: As in 14:11: the English sets "themselves/himself". Portuguese "quem" and the reflexive "se" carry no gender, so the saying already includes everyone.

decisions.choice: ጸድቆ (having been justified, L); በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቅ ሆኖ (right with God, B)
decisions.reason: "መጽደቅ" is the word for being declared right with God, from the same root as "ጻድቅ" (18:9), so the contrast with the Pharisee stays visible.

decisions.choice: ራሱን (himself), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The reflexive suffix is Amharic's general form for anyone, so there is no second wording for the setting.

decisions.choice: "себя", with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span on the pronoun
decisions.reason: The English has gender spans on "themselves|himself"; the Russian reflexive "себя" is the same for either sex.

decisions.choice: "धर्मी ठहरकर" (L); "परमेश्वर के साथ सही होकर" (B); "परमेश्वर ने ... अपनी नज़र में सही मान लिया" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the church word for being justified; Balanced and Readable say what it means, declared right with God (meaning decision m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "виправданим" (L); "виправданим перед Богом" (B); "Бог прийняв ... як праведного" (R)
decisions.reason: "Виправдати" is the settled Ukrainian term for being declared right with God; "оправдати" is the older, Russian-coloured form.

decisions.choice: "義とされて" (L); "神に義とされて" (B); "神に正しい者と認められて" (R)
decisions.reason: The brief's forms for "justify"; Balanced names God, as the English Balanced does with "put right with God".

decisions.choice: "自分" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs a span for "themselves / himself"; Japanese "自分" includes everyone.

source.text: Προσέφερον δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ τὰ βρέφη ἵνα αὐτῶν ἅπτηται· ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμων αὐτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: They were bringing then to him also the infants, that them he might touch; having seen however the disciples were rebuking them.

en.L: And they were bringing even the infants to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might touch them; but the disciples, having seen [it], were rebuking them.
en.B: People were even bringing their babies to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would touch them. The disciples saw it and began to scold them.
en.R: People were bringing even their babies to Jesus. They wanted {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to touch them. But when the disciples saw this, they told the people to stop.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} traían también los bebés para que los tocara; pero los discípulos, al ver[lo], los reprendían.
es.B: La gente {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} traía incluso a sus bebés para que los tocara. Al ver esto, los discípulos comenzaron a reprenderlos.
es.R: La gente llevaba incluso a sus bebés a Jesús. Querían que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los tocara. Pero cuando los discípulos vieron esto, les dijeron a esas personas que no lo hicieran.

fr.L: Et on {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amenait même les nourrissons pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les touche ; mais les disciples, voyant [cela], les réprimandaient.
fr.B: Des gens {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amenaient même leurs bébés pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les touche. Quand les disciples virent cela, ils se mirent à les rabrouer.
fr.R: Des gens amenaient même leurs bébés à Jésus. Ils voulaient qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les touche. Mais quand les disciples ont vu cela, ils ont dit aux gens d’arrêter.

sw.L: Na walikuwa wakimletea hata watoto wachanga ili awaguse; lakini wanafunzi, walipoona, walikuwa wakiwakemea.
sw.B: Watu walikuwa wakimletea hata watoto wao wachanga ili awaguse. Wanafunzi walipoona hivyo, wakaanza kuwakemea.
sw.R: Watu walikuwa wakimletea Yesu hata watoto wao wachanga. Walitaka awaguse. Lakini wanafunzi walipoona hivyo, waliwaambia watu hao waache.

vi.L: [Người ta] cũng đem cả các trẻ sơ sinh đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạm vào chúng; nhưng thấy [vậy], các môn đồ quở trách họ.
vi.B: Người ta còn đem cả các em bé đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạm vào các em. Các môn đồ thấy vậy thì bắt đầu rầy la họ.
vi.R: Người ta đem cả những em bé của mình đến với Đức Giê-xu. Họ muốn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạm vào các em. Nhưng khi các môn đồ thấy vậy, họ bảo người ta đừng làm thế.

ko.L: 그런데 사람들이 그분께 아기들까지 데려오고 있었다. 그분이 그들을 만져 주시게 하려는 것이었다. 그러나 제자들은 [그것을] 보고 그들을 꾸짖었다.
ko.B: 사람들이 아기들까지 예수께 데려왔다. 예수께서 아기들을 만져 주시기를 바랐던 것이다. 그런데 제자들이 이것을 보고 그 사람들을 꾸짖었다.
ko.R: 사람들이 자기 아기들까지 예수께 데려왔다. 예수께서 아기들에게 손을 얹고 복을 빌어 주시기를 바랐던 것이다. 그런데 제자들은 이것을 보고, 그 사람들에게 그러지 말라고 나무랐다.

pt.L: E traziam-{{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} também os bebês, para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os tocasse; mas os discípulos, vendo [isso], os repreendiam.
pt.B: Algumas pessoas traziam a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} até mesmo os seus bebês, para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os tocasse. Quando os discípulos viram isso, começaram a repreender essas pessoas.
pt.R: Algumas pessoas estavam levando os seus bebês até Jesus. Elas queriam que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tocasse neles. Mas, quando os discípulos viram isso, mandaram essas pessoas parar.

am.L: ሕፃናትንም ደግሞ እንዲዳስሳቸው ወደ እርሱ ያመጡ ነበር፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ግን አይተው ይገሥጿቸው ነበር።
am.B: ሰዎችም እንዲዳስሳቸው ሕፃናቶቻቸውን እንኳ ወደ እርሱ ያመጡ ነበር። ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ግን ይህን አይተው ይገሥጿቸው ጀመር።
am.R: ሰዎች ሕፃናት ልጆቻቸውን እንኳ ወደ ኢየሱስ ያመጡ ነበር። እንዲዳስሳቸው ፈልገው ነበር። ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ግን ይህን ባዩ ጊዜ ሰዎቹ እንዲያቆሙ ነገሯቸው።

ru.L: Приносили же к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} и младенцев, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} прикоснулся к ним; а ученики, увидев [это], укоряли их.
ru.B: Люди приносили к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} даже младенцев, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} прикоснулся к ним. Ученики увидели это и стали их бранить.
ru.R: Люди приносили к Иисусу даже своих малышей. Они хотели, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} прикоснулся к ним. Но когда ученики увидели это, они сказали людям, чтобы те перестали.

hi.L: और [लोग] शिशुओं को भी उनके पास ला रहे थे कि वे उन्हें छुएँ; पर चेले [यह] देखकर उन्हें डाँटने लगे।
hi.B: लोग अपने छोटे-छोटे बच्चों को भी उनके पास ला रहे थे, ताकि वे उन्हें छू दें। चेलों ने यह देखा और उन लोगों को झिड़कने लगे।
hi.R: लोग अपने छोटे बच्चों को भी यीशु के पास ला रहे थे। वे चाहते थे कि यीशु उन्हें छुएँ। पर जब चेलों ने यह देखा, तो उन्होंने उन लोगों को रोक दिया।

uk.L: Приносили ж до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} і немовлят, щоб {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} доторкнувся до них; а учні, побачивши [це], докоряли їм.
uk.B: Люди приносили до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} навіть своїх немовлят, щоб {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} доторкнувся до них. Учні побачили це й почали їм докоряти.
uk.R: Люди приносили до Ісуса навіть своїх немовлят. Вони хотіли, щоб {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} доторкнувся до них. Але коли учні побачили це, вони сказали людям, щоб ті перестали.

ja.L: また人々は、触れていただこうとして、乳飲み子たちまでもイエスのもとに連れて来ていた。しかし弟子たちはこれを見て、彼らを叱っていた。
ja.B: 人々は、乳飲み子までもイエスのもとに連れて来て、触れていただこうとした。ところが弟子たちはこれを見て、その人々を叱りつけた。
ja.R: 人々は、自分の赤ちゃんまで、イエスのところに連れて来ました。イエスに触れていただきたかったのです。ところが弟子たちはこれを見て、その人たちに、やめなさいと言いました。

decisions.choice: infants: babies
decisions.reason: The word means a newborn or very young child. In 18:16 Jesus calls them little children.

decisions.choice: touch them: lay hands on them in blessing
decisions.reason: Parents brought children to a teacher to be blessed with his touch (compare Mark 10:16; Genesis 48:14).

decisions.choice: were rebuking them: those who brought the children
decisions.reason: The disciples spoke sternly to the people bringing the children, perhaps thinking Jesus had more important work.

decisions.choice: told the people to stop
decisions.reason: Readable says whom the disciples spoke to and what they said.

decisions.choice: "trẻ sơ sinh" (L); "các em bé" (B, R) for the infants; "chúng" (L), "các em" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke's word is babies (meaning decision). As in Mark 10:13-16, Balanced and Readable speak of children warmly as "các em".

decisions.choice: "아기들" for brephe; "만져 주시다" (L, B), "손을 얹고 복을 빌어 주시다" (R)
decisions.reason: Luke's word is babies (meaning decision); the touch is a blessing, which Readable says as the Korean Mark 10:13 does.

decisions.choice: os repreendiam, masculine
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 19:13, the masculine "os" points to the people who brought the babies (m3); Balanced and Readable name "essas pessoas".
Hindi needs a subject for "they were bringing"; without it the honorific plural for Jesus and the plural of the people would run together.

decisions.choice: "乳飲み子" (L, B); "赤ちゃん" (R)
decisions.reason: Luke's word is for babies (m1), where Mark 10:13 has "children"; the rest of 18:15-17 follows the wording of Mark 10:13-15.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς προσεκαλέσατο αὐτὰ λέγων· Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία ἔρχεσθαι πρός με καὶ μὴ κωλύετε αὐτά, τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: But Jesus called them to [him] saying, Permit the little children to come to me and not do forbid them, for of such is the kingdom of God.

en.L: But Jesus called them to [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}], saying, "Allow the little children to come to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and do not forbid them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
en.B: But Jesus called them over and said, "Let the little children come to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and do not try to stop them. The kingdom of God belongs to those who are like them.
en.R: But Jesus called for the children to come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He said, "Let the children come to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}! Do not keep them away. The kingdom of God belongs to people who are like them.

es.L: Pero Jesús los llamó [junto a {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}}], diciendo: «{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} que los niños vengan a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y no se lo {{plural_you:impidan|impidáis}}, porque de los que son como estos es el reino de Dios.
es.B: Pero Jesús los llamó y dijo: «{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} que los niños pequeños vengan a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y no {{plural_you:traten|tratéis}} de impedírselo. El reino de Dios pertenece a los que son como ellos.
es.R: Pero Jesús llamó a los niños para que vinieran a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} que los niños vengan a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}! No los {{plural_you:aparten|apartéis}}. El reino de Dios es de las personas que son como ellos.

fr.L: Mais Jésus les appela [auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}], en disant : « Laissez les petits enfants venir à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et ne les en empêchez pas, car le royaume de Dieu appartient à leurs pareils.
fr.B: Mais Jésus les fit venir et dit : « Laissez les petits enfants venir à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et n’essayez pas de les en empêcher. Le royaume de Dieu appartient à ceux qui sont comme eux.
fr.R: Mais Jésus a demandé qu’on fasse venir les enfants auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il a dit : « Laissez les enfants venir vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ! Ne les écartez pas. Le royaume de Dieu est à ceux qui sont comme eux.

sw.L: Lakini Yesu aliwaita [{{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}], akisema, "Waruhusuni watoto wadogo kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, na msiwakataze, kwa maana ufalme wa Mungu ni mali ya walio kama hawa.
sw.B: Lakini Yesu aliwaita, akasema, "Waacheni watoto wadogo wanijie. Msijaribu kuwazuia. Ufalme wa Mungu ni mali ya watu walio kama wao.
sw.R: Lakini Yesu aliwaita watoto waje {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Akasema, "Waruhusuni watoto waje {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}! Msiwafukuze. Ufalme wa Mungu ni wa watu walio kama wao.

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu gọi chúng đến [với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] mà nói: "Hãy để các trẻ nhỏ đến với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đừng ngăn cản chúng, vì vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời thuộc về những ai giống như chúng.
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu gọi các em lại và nói: "Hãy để các em nhỏ đến với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đừng ngăn cản các em. Vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời thuộc về những người giống như các em.
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu gọi các em đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài nói: "Hãy để các em nhỏ đến với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! Đừng ngăn các em lại. Vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời thuộc về những người giống như các em.

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서 그들을 [가까이] 부르시며 말씀하셨다. "어린아이들이 내게 오는 것을 허락하고, 그들을 막지 마라. 하나님의 나라는 이런 사람들의 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서 아기들을 가까이 부르시며 말씀하셨다. "어린아이들이 내게 오게 두어라. 막지 마라. 하나님의 나라는 이런 사람들의 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 예수께서 아이들을 가까이 오게 하셨다. 그리고 말씀하셨다. "어린아이들이 내게 오게 해라! 막지 마라! 하나님의 나라는 이 아이들과 같은 사람들의 것이다.

pt.L: Mas Jesus os chamou [para junto de {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}}], dizendo: "Deixem as criancinhas virem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e não as impeçam, pois o Reino de Deus pertence aos que são assim.
pt.B: Mas Jesus chamou as crianças para perto e disse: "Deixem as crianças virem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e não tentem impedi-las. O Reino de Deus pertence aos que são como elas.
pt.R: Mas Jesus chamou as crianças para perto {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Ele disse: "Deixem as crianças virem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}! Não as mandem embora. O Reino de Deus pertence às pessoas que são como elas.

am.L: ኢየሱስ ግን ጠራቸውና እንዲህ አለ፦ «ሕፃናት ወደ እኔ እንዲመጡ ተዉአቸው፤ አትከልክሏቸውም፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደነዚህ ላሉት ናትና።
am.B: ኢየሱስ ግን ጠራቸውና እንዲህ አለ፦ «ልጆቹ ወደ እኔ ይምጡ፤ አትከልክሏቸው። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደ እነርሱ ላሉት ናትና።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ግን ልጆቹ ወደ እርሱ እንዲመጡ ጠራቸው። እንዲህም አለ፦ «ትንንሽ ልጆች ወደ እኔ ይምጡ! አትከልክሏቸው። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደነዚህ ልጆች ላሉ ሰዎች ናት።

ru.L: Но Иисус подозвал их, говоря: «Пустите детей приходить ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} и не мешайте им, ведь таким принадлежит Царство Божье.
ru.B: Но Иисус подозвал их и сказал: «Пусть дети приходят ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}. Не мешайте им, потому что Царство Божье принадлежит таким, как они.
ru.R: Но Иисус позвал детей к себе. Он сказал: «Пусть дети приходят ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}! Не прогоняйте их. Царство Божье принадлежит тем, кто похож на этих детей.

hi.L: पर यीशु ने उन्हें [अपने] पास बुलाते हुए कहा, "बच्चों को मेरे पास आने दो, और उन्हें मत रोको, क्योंकि परमेश्वर का राज्य ऐसों ही का है।
hi.B: पर यीशु ने बच्चों को पास बुलाया और कहा, "बच्चों को मेरे पास आने दो। उन्हें रोकने की कोशिश मत करो, क्योंकि परमेश्वर का राज्य ऐसे ही लोगों का है।
hi.R: पर यीशु ने बच्चों को अपने पास बुलाया। उन्होंने कहा, "बच्चों को मेरे पास आने दो! उन्हें दूर मत रखो। परमेश्वर का राज्य उन लोगों का है जो इन बच्चों जैसे हैं।

uk.L: Ісус же прикликав їх [до себе], кажучи: «Пустіть дітей приходити до {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} і не забороняйте їм, бо таким належить Царство Боже.
uk.B: Але Ісус покликав їх до себе й сказав: «Пустіть дітей до {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} і не перешкоджайте їм. Царство Боже належить тим, хто подібний до них.
uk.R: Але Ісус покликав дітей до себе. Він сказав: «Пустіть дітей до {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}! Не відганяйте їх. Царство Боже належить людям, які схожі на них.

ja.L: しかしイエスはその子たちを呼び寄せて言われた。「子どもたちを、わたしのところに来させなさい。妨げてはならない。神の国はこのような者たちのものだからである。
ja.B: しかしイエスは子どもたちを呼び寄せて言われた。「子どもたちをわたしのところに来させなさい。止めてはならない。神の国は、このような者たちのものなのだ。
ja.R: でもイエスは、子どもたちをそばに呼んで、言われました。「子どもたちを、わたしのところに来させなさい！追い返してはいけない。神の国は、この子どもたちのような人たちのものなのだ。

decisions.choice: called them: the babies, brought to him by those carrying them
decisions.reason: The word "them" refers back to the infants of 18:15.

decisions.choice: of such is the kingdom of God: the kingdom belongs to people like these
alternatives: the kingdom is made up only of children
decisions.reason: Children had nothing to offer and no standing. The kingdom belongs to those who, like them, come with nothing in their hands.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs to 18:17
decisions.reason: Jesus' words in 18:16-17 are one saying.

decisions.choice: le royaume de Dieu at every level
decisions.reason: The style guide's term for the New Testament, as in Luke 17 and Mark: the same words at every level, Readable included.

decisions.choice: "vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời" for the kingdom of God, at every level, with the wording of Mark 10:14
decisions.reason: The parallel saying reads alike where the Greek is alike; "vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời" is the term used through Luke and Mark.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 나라는 이런 사람들의 것" at every level
decisions.reason: Word for word as the Korean Mark 10:14, which this saying matches.

decisions.choice: ጠራቸው (called them), with no bracketed "to him"
decisions.reason: The Amharic verb already means calling someone to oneself; the rest follows the Amharic of Matthew 19:14, where the Greek is the same, with "the kingdom of God" for Luke.

decisions.choice: Jesus' words as in Mark 10:14
decisions.reason: The Greek of the saying is the same as in Mark 10:14, so the Hindi keeps Mark's wording at each level; 18:17 likewise follows Mark 10:15.

decisions.choice: Jesus' words as in Mark 10:14
decisions.reason: The Greek of Jesus' saying is the same as in Mark 10:14, so the Japanese keeps Mark's wording at each level.

source.text: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὃς ἂν μὴ δέξηται τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ ὡς παιδίον, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτήν.

records.literal_gloss: Truly I say to you, whoever not shall receive the kingdom of God as a child, no not shall enter into it.

en.L: Truly I tell you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God like a child will never enter into it."
en.B: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not welcome the kingdom of God the way a child does will never get into it."
en.R: I tell you the truth, you must accept the kingdom of God the way a child does. If you do not, you will never enter it."

es.L: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: el que no reciba el reino de Dios como un niño, de ningún modo entrará en él».
es.B: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que quien no acoja el reino de Dios como lo acoge un niño nunca entrará en él».
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: hay que recibir el reino de Dios como lo recibe un niño. El que no lo reciba así nunca entrará en él».

fr.L: En vérité, je vous le dis, celui qui ne reçoit pas le royaume de Dieu comme un enfant n’y entrera jamais. »
fr.B: En vérité, je vous le dis, celui qui n’accueille pas le royaume de Dieu à la manière d’un enfant n’y entrera jamais. »
fr.R: Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : vous devez accueillir le royaume de Dieu comme un enfant l’accueille. Sinon, vous n’y entrerez jamais. »

sw.L: Kweli nawaambia, yeyote ambaye hataupokea ufalme wa Mungu kama mtoto, hakika hataingia ndani yake."
sw.B: Kweli nawaambia, mtu yeyote asiyeukaribisha ufalme wa Mungu jinsi mtoto anavyoukaribisha, hataingia ndani yake kamwe."
sw.R: Nawaambia ukweli, ni lazima mtu aupokee ufalme wa Mungu jinsi mtoto anavyoupokea. Asipoupokea hivyo, hataingia ndani yake kamwe."

vi.L: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, ai không tiếp nhận vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời như một đứa trẻ thì nhất định sẽ không được vào đó."
vi.B: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, ai không đón nhận vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời như một em nhỏ đón nhận thì chắc chắn sẽ không bao giờ được vào đó."
vi.R: Ta nói thật với các con: các con phải đón nhận vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời như một em nhỏ. Nếu không, các con sẽ không bao giờ được vào đó."

ko.L: 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 누구든지 하나님의 나라를 어린아이처럼 받아들이지 않으면, 결코 그곳에 들어가지 못할 것이다."
ko.B: 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 누구든지 어린아이가 받아들이듯이 하나님의 나라를 받아들이지 않으면, 결코 그곳에 들어가지 못할 것이다."
ko.R: 내가 분명히 말한다. 너희는 어린아이가 받아들이듯이 하나님의 나라를 받아들여야 한다. 그렇게 하지 않으면 결코 그 나라에 들어가지 못할 것이다."

pt.L: Em verdade eu lhes digo: quem não receber o Reino de Deus como uma criança de modo nenhum entrará nele."
pt.B: Em verdade eu lhes digo: quem não receber o Reino de Deus do jeito que uma criança recebe nunca vai entrar nele."
pt.R: Eu garanto a vocês: vocês precisam receber o Reino de Deus do jeito que uma criança recebe. Se não fizerem isso, nunca vão entrar nele."

am.L: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፣ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እንደ ሕፃን የማይቀበላት ሁሉ ወደ እርሷ ከቶ አይገባም።»
am.B: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፣ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ሕፃን እንደሚቀበል አድርጎ የማይቀበል ማንም ቢሆን ፈጽሞ አይገባባትም።»
am.R: እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ፣ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ሕፃን እንደሚቀበል መቀበል አለባችሁ። ካልተቀበላችሁ ፈጽሞ አትገቡባትም።»

ru.L: Истинно говорю вам: кто не примет Царства Божьего, как ребёнок, тот никак не войдёт в него.»
ru.B: Истинно говорю вам: кто не примет Царство Божье так, как принимает его ребёнок, тот никогда в него не войдёт.»
ru.R: Говорю вам правду: вы должны принять Царство Божье так, как принял бы его ребёнок. Если вы этого не сделаете, вы никогда в него не войдёте.»

hi.L: मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ, जो कोई परमेश्वर के राज्य को बालक की तरह ग्रहण न करे, वह उसमें कदापि प्रवेश न करेगा।"
hi.B: मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ, जो कोई परमेश्वर के राज्य को उस तरह ग्रहण नहीं करता जैसे एक बच्चा करता है, वह उसमें कभी प्रवेश नहीं कर पाएगा।"
hi.R: मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ, तुम्हें परमेश्वर के राज्य को उसी तरह अपनाना होगा जैसे एक बच्चा अपनाता है। अगर तुम ऐसा नहीं करोगे, तो तुम उसमें कभी नहीं जा पाओगे।"

uk.L: Істинно кажу вам: хто не прийме Царства Божого, як дитина, той не ввійде до нього.»
uk.B: Істинно кажу вам: хто не прийме Царства Божого так, як приймає дитина, той ніколи до нього не ввійде.»
uk.R: Кажу вам правду: ви повинні прийняти Царство Боже так, як його приймає дитина. Якщо ви цього не зробите, ви ніколи до нього не ввійдете.»

ja.L: アーメン、あなたがたに言う。子どものように神の国を受け入れない者は、決してそこに入ることはない。」
ja.B: まことに、あなたがたに言っておく。子どもが受け入れるように神の国を受け入れない者は、決してそこに入ることはできない。」
ja.R: 本当のことを言おう。あなたたちは、子どものように神の国を迎え入れなければならない。そうしなければ、決してそこに入ることはできない。」

decisions.choice: like a child: as a child receives it
decisions.reason: The words could mean receiving the kingdom as one welcomes a child, but the context is about being like children (18:16). A child receives what is given, with trust.

decisions.choice: will never enter: the strongest form of denial
alternatives: will find it hard to enter
decisions.reason: The double negative makes the statement emphatic.

decisions.choice: Truly I tell you (L, B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: Luke's usual rendering of Jesus' "amen" (4:24).

decisions.choice: two sentences, addressed to "you"
decisions.reason: Readable puts the condition as a direct instruction.

decisions.choice: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo (L, B); {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: The New Testament rendering of the single amen, as in Matthew and Mark. Jesus speaks to the disciples together, so the plural "you" takes the ustedes / vosotros setting. The same in verse 29.

decisions.choice: hay que recibir ... El que no lo reciba así
decisions.reason: The English Readable turns the saying to "you" (English decision r-en-2). In Spanish a "you" here would have to be singular or plural, and either would narrow it; "hay que" and "el que" keep it open to anyone, as the Greek is, and as in Mark 10:15.

decisions.choice: En vérité, je vous le dis (L, B); Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for Jesus's solemn formula, as in Mark 10:15, which has the same saying. Readable puts it in an everyday sentence, as the English Readable does. The same in 18:29.

decisions.choice: Kweli nawaambia (L, B); Nawaambia ukweli (R)
decisions.reason: The New Testament rendering of the single amen, as in Matthew and Mark. The same in verse 29.

decisions.choice: ni lazima mtu aupokee ... Asipoupokea hivyo
decisions.reason: The English Readable turns the saying to "you" (English decision r-en-2). Swahili "you" would have to be singular or plural, and either would narrow it; "mtu" (a person) keeps it open to anyone, as the Greek is, and as in Mark 10:15.

decisions.choice: "Thật vậy, Ta nói với các con" (L, B); "Ta nói thật với các con" (R), also 18:29
decisions.reason: The form settled for amen in the Gospels; "các con" because Jesus speaks to his disciples.

decisions.choice: "진실로 너희에게 말한다" (L, B); "내가 분명히 말한다" (R), through Luke 18
decisions.reason: The settled Korean form of the single amen, and the wording of the parallel Mark 10:15.

decisions.choice: Em verdade eu lhes digo (L, B); Eu garanto a vocês (R)
decisions.reason: For this passage (also 18:29): the solemn opening in the words set for the New Testament (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 6); Readable says "Eu garanto a vocês", the plain Brazilian way of vouching for what follows, as in Matthew and Mark.

decisions.choice: እውነት እላችኋለሁ (L, B); እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ (R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets: Jesus' "amen" before a saying makes it solemn, which "እውነት እላችኋለሁ" carries in Amharic, while "አሜን" is heard as the close of a prayer. The same holds in 18:29.

decisions.choice: "Истинно говорю вам" (L, B); "Говорю вам правду" (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide forms of the style guide for "amen" with "I tell you"; the wording keeps Mark 10:15, where the Greek is the same (also 18:29).

decisions.choice: "मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ" at every level
decisions.reason: The fixed form of "Truly I tell you" through the book, as the style guide settles it in Matthew; also in 18:29.

decisions.choice: "Істинно кажу вам" (L, B); "Кажу вам правду" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled rendering of *amēn* at the head of a saying; "Справді кажу вам" is kept for *alēthōs*.

decisions.choice: "アーメン、あなたがたに言う" (L); "まことに、あなたがたに言っておく" (B); "本当のことを言おう" (R)
decisions.reason: The shared Gospel form for Jesus' "amen" (4:24); the whole verse is word for word Mark 10:15 in Greek and keeps Mark's Japanese.

source.text: Καὶ ἐπηρώτησέν τις αὐτὸν ἄρχων λέγων· Διδάσκαλε ἀγαθέ, τί ποιήσας ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσω;

records.literal_gloss: And asked a certain him ruler saying, Teacher good, what having done life eternal will I inherit?

en.L: And a certain ruler asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, saying, "Good Teacher, by doing what will I inherit eternal life?"
en.B: One of the leaders asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Good Teacher, what do I have to do to inherit eternal life?"
en.R: An important leader asked Jesus, "Good Teacher, what must I do to have eternal life?"

es.L: Y cierto dirigente {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntó, diciendo: «Maestro bueno, ¿haciendo qué heredaré vida eterna?».
es.B: Uno de los dirigentes {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntó: «Maestro bueno, ¿qué tengo que hacer para heredar la vida eterna?».
es.R: Un líder importante preguntó a Jesús: «Maestro bueno, ¿qué debo hacer para tener la vida eterna?».

fr.L: Et un dirigeant {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interrogea, en disant : « Bon Maître, en faisant quoi hériterai-je de la vie éternelle ? »
fr.B: Un des dirigeants {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demanda : « Bon Maître, que dois-je faire pour recevoir en héritage la vie éternelle ? »
fr.R: Un dirigeant important a demandé à Jésus : « Bon Maître, qu’est-ce que je dois faire pour avoir la vie éternelle ? »

sw.L: Na kiongozi fulani akamwuliza, akisema, "Mwalimu mwema, nikifanya nini nitaurithi uzima wa milele?"
sw.B: Kiongozi mmoja alimwuliza, "Mwalimu mwema, nifanye nini ili niurithi uzima wa milele?"
sw.R: Kiongozi mmoja mashuhuri alimwuliza Yesu, "Mwalimu mwema, nifanye nini ili nipate uzima wa milele?"

vi.L: Có một người lãnh đạo kia hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rằng: "Thưa Thầy nhân lành, tôi phải làm gì để thừa hưởng sự sống đời đời?"
vi.B: Có một người trong giới lãnh đạo hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy nhân lành, tôi phải làm gì để được hưởng sự sống đời đời?"
vi.R: Một nhà lãnh đạo quan trọng hỏi Đức Giê-xu: "Thưa Thầy tốt lành, tôi phải làm gì để có được sự sống đời đời?"

ko.L: 그리고 어떤 지도자가 그분께 물었다. "선한 선생님, 제가 무엇을 하여야 영원한 생명을 상속받겠습니까?"
ko.B: 어떤 지도자가 예수께 여쭈었다. "선한 선생님, 제가 영원한 생명을 상속받으려면 무엇을 해야 합니까?"
ko.R: 높은 자리에 있는 어떤 지도자가 예수께 여쭈었다. "선한 선생님, 하나님께서 주시는 영원한 생명을 받으려면 제가 무엇을 해야 합니까?"

pt.L: E um certo líder {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} perguntou, dizendo: "Bom Mestre, que farei para herdar a vida eterna?"
pt.B: Um dos líderes {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} perguntou: "Bom Mestre, o que eu preciso fazer para herdar a vida eterna?"
pt.R: Um líder importante perguntou a Jesus: "Bom Mestre, o que eu devo fazer para ter a vida eterna?"

am.L: አንድ ባለ ሥልጣንም፦ «መልካም መምህር ሆይ፣ ምን አድርጌ የዘላለምን ሕይወት እወርሳለሁ?» ብሎ ጠየቀው።
am.B: ከባለ ሥልጣናቱ አንዱ «መልካም መምህር ሆይ፣ የዘላለም ሕይወትን ለመውረስ ምን ማድረግ አለብኝ?» ብሎ ጠየቀው።
am.R: አንድ ታላቅ መሪ ኢየሱስን «መልካም መምህር ሆይ፣ የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዲኖረኝ ምን ማድረግ አለብኝ?» ብሎ ጠየቀው።

ru.L: И спросил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} некий начальник, говоря: «Учитель добрый, что мне сделать, чтобы наследовать вечную жизнь?»
ru.B: Один из начальников спросил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}: «Добрый Учитель, что мне делать, чтобы унаследовать вечную жизнь?»
ru.R: Один важный человек спросил Иисуса: «Добрый Учитель, что мне нужно сделать, чтобы получить вечную жизнь?»

hi.L: और एक सरदार ने उनसे यह पूछा, "हे भले गुरु, अनन्त जीवन का वारिस होने के लिए मैं क्या करूँ?"
hi.B: एक अगुवे ने उनसे पूछा, "हे भले गुरु, अनन्त जीवन का वारिस होने के लिए मुझे क्या करना चाहिए?"
hi.R: एक बड़े अगुवे ने यीशु से पूछा, "हे भले गुरु, अनन्त जीवन पाने के लिए मुझे क्या करना होगा?"

uk.L: І спитав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} один начальник, кажучи: «Учителю добрий, що зробивши, я успадкую вічне життя?»
uk.B: Один із провідників спитав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}: «Добрий Учителю, що мені робити, щоб успадкувати вічне життя?»
uk.R: Один впливовий провідник спитав Ісуса: «Добрий Учителю, що я повинен зробити, щоб мати вічне життя?»

ja.L: また、ある指導者がイエスに尋ねて言った。「善い先生、何をしたら、わたしは永遠の命を受け継ぐでしょうか？」
ja.B: ある指導者がイエスに尋ねた。「善い先生、永遠の命を受け継ぐには、何をしたらよいのでしょうか？」
ja.R: 身分の高い指導者が、イエスに聞きました。「善い先生、神から永遠の命をいただくには、何をしなければなりませんか？」

decisions.choice: ruler: a leader, perhaps of a synagogue or of the Jewish council
decisions.reason: The word is used for leaders of a synagogue (8:41) and members of the council (23:13). Luke does not say which. He is rich (18:23), and Matthew 19:20 says he was young.

decisions.choice: Good Teacher: a respectful, even flattering, form of address
alternatives: a statement that Jesus is God
decisions.reason: Jewish teachers were not usually addressed as "good". Jesus' reply (18:19) takes up the word.

decisions.choice: inherit eternal life: receive the life of the age to come
decisions.reason: As in 10:25. Eternal life is the life of the age to come (Daniel 12:2; 18:30).

decisions.choice: have
decisions.reason: As in 10:25: Readable uses a simpler verb; the meaning decision explains "inherit".

decisions.choice: dirigente (L, B); líder importante (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a leader, perhaps of a synagogue or of the Jewish council (meaning decision m1); Luke does not say which. "Dirigente" is a plain word for a leader of a community; "príncipe" now suggests royalty and "principal" as a noun is old-fashioned.

decisions.choice: un dirigeant; Bon Maître at every level
decisions.reason: The man is a leader of some kind (m1): "un chef" sounds like a boss today and "un notable" names a social rank, so "dirigeant" is used. French addresses a teacher of the Law as "Maître", as in Mark 10:17; "Enseignant" would sound like a school.

decisions.choice: kiongozi
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a leader, perhaps of a synagogue or of the Jewish council (meaning decision m1); Luke does not say which. "Kiongozi" is the plain word for a leader of a community; "mtu mkubwa" would mean only an important person.

decisions.choice: uzima wa milele (every level)
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts, as in John: "uzima" is life itself, the life of the age to come (meaning decision m3), where "maisha" would be a lifetime or daily living. The same in verse 30.

decisions.choice: "người lãnh đạo" for the ruler
decisions.reason: A leader, perhaps of a synagogue or of the council (meaning decision), not a government official, which "quan" would suggest.

decisions.choice: "Thưa Thầy nhân lành" (L, B), "Thưa Thầy tốt lành" (R); "thừa hưởng" (L), "được hưởng" (B), "có được" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 10:17, the parallel: "nhân lành" is goodness of character, which Jesus takes up in 18:19.

decisions.choice: "지도자" for archon; "선한 선생님"; "영원한 생명을 상속받다" (L, B), "하나님께서 주시는 영원한 생명을 받다" (R)
decisions.reason: The ruler's office is uncertain (meaning decision), so "지도자" names no particular office; the question is worded as in the Korean Luke 10:25 and Mark 10:17.

decisions.choice: líder
decisions.reason: Luke does not say what kind of leader he was (m1). "Líder" leaves it open; "chefe" sounds like a boss at work, "príncipe" is a king's son, and "magistrado" is a judge.

decisions.choice: ባለ ሥልጣን (official, L, B); ታላቅ መሪ (an important leader, R)
decisions.reason: "አለቃ" is used for Jesus as "Master" in 17:13, so the ruler takes a different word.

decisions.choice: መልካም መምህር (Good Teacher)
decisions.reason: "መልካም" is the same word Jesus takes up in 18:19 ("why do you call me good?"), as in Matthew 19:16-17; "ቸር" means kind and would hide the link.

decisions.choice: "начальник" (L, B); "важный человек" (R)
decisions.reason: A leader of the community, as the meaning decision says, not a ruler of a country; "правитель" and the Synodal "начальник" both say more or less than that, and Readable says only that he was important.

decisions.choice: "सरदार" (L); "अगुवा" (B); "बड़ा अगुवा" (R)
decisions.reason: The man was a leader, perhaps of a synagogue or the council (meaning decision m1), not a ruler of a land, which "शासक" would suggest. His question is worded as in Mark 10:17, where the Greek is the same.

decisions.choice: "指導者" (L, B); "身分の高い指導者" (R)
decisions.reason: Luke does not say what kind of leader he was (m1), so a general word is used; Readable adds that he was a man of standing, as the English Readable does. The rest of 18:18-30 follows the terms of Mark 10:17-30 ("善い先生", "戒め", the camel and the needle).

decisions.choice: "受け継ぐ" (L, B); "いただく" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 10:17, Readable uses a simpler verb; the meaning decision (m3) explains "inherit".

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Τί με λέγεις ἀγαθόν;

records.literal_gloss: Said then to him Jesus, Why me call you good?

en.L: And Jesus said to him, "Why do you call {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} good?
en.B: Jesus answered, "Why are you calling {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} good?
en.R: Jesus said to him, "Why do you say that I am good?

es.L: Y Jesús le dijo: «¿Por qué {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamas bueno?
es.B: Jesús le respondió: «¿Por qué {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamas bueno?
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «¿Por qué dices que yo soy bueno?

fr.L: Et Jésus lui dit : « Pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appelles-tu bon ?
fr.B: Jésus répondit : « Pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appelles-tu bon ?
fr.R: Jésus lui a dit : « Pourquoi dis-tu que je suis bon ?

sw.L: Naye Yesu akamwambia, "Mbona unaniita mwema?
sw.B: Yesu alijibu, "Kwa nini unaniita mwema?
sw.R: Yesu alimwambia, "Kwa nini unasema kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni mwema?

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu nói với người ấy: "Sao ông gọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là nhân lành?
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Sao ông gọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là nhân lành?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với ông: "Tại sao ông nói {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là tốt lành?

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "어찌하여 너는 나를 선하다고 하느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "왜 너는 나를 선하다고 하느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 너는 내가 선하다고 말하느냐?

pt.L: E Jesus lhe disse: "Por que você {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chama de bom?
pt.B: Jesus respondeu: "Por que você está {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chamando de bom?
pt.R: Jesus disse a ele: "Por que você diz que eu sou bom?

am.L: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አለው፦ «ስለ ምን መልካም ትለኛለህ?
am.B: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰለት፦ «ለምን መልካም ትለኛለህ?
am.R: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አለው፦ «እኔ መልካም እንደ ሆንኩ ለምን ትናገራለህ?

ru.L: Иисус же сказал ему: «Почему ты называешь {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} добрым?
ru.B: Иисус ответил: «Почему ты называешь {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} добрым?
ru.R: Иисус сказал ему: «Почему ты говоришь, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} добрый?

hi.L: यीशु ने उससे कहा, "तुम मुझे भला क्यों कहते हो?
hi.B: यीशु ने उत्तर दिया, "तुम मुझे भला क्यों कह रहे हो?
hi.R: यीशु ने उससे कहा, "तुम यह क्यों कहते हो कि मैं भला हूँ?

uk.L: Сказав же йому Ісус: «Чому ти називаєш {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} добрим?
uk.B: Ісус відповів: «Чому ти називаєш {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} добрим?
uk.R: Ісус сказав йому: «Чому ти кажеш, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} добрий?

ja.L: イエスは彼に言われた。「なぜ、わたしを善いと言うのか？
ja.B: イエスは答えられた。「なぜ、わたしを善い者と呼ぶのか？
ja.R: イエスはその人に言われました。「なぜ、わたしが善いと言うのか？

decisions.choice: why do you call me good: Jesus makes the man think about what he has said
alternatives: Jesus denies that he is good
decisions.reason: Jesus does not say he is not good. He turns the man's attention to God, the only one who is good, and leaves him to ask what it means to call Jesus good.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs to 18:20
decisions.reason: Jesus' reply runs on without a break.

decisions.choice: "ông" for the ruler when Jesus speaks to him (18:19-22)
decisions.reason: Luke makes the man a ruler, a man of standing (meaning decision on 18:18), where Mark's and Matthew's man is addressed as a younger man, "anh"; "ông" gives him the respect his position carries.

source.text: οὐδεὶς ἀγαθὸς εἰ μὴ εἷς ὁ θεός.

records.literal_gloss: No one [is] good except one, God.

en.L: No one [is] good except one: God.
en.B: No one is good but God alone.
en.R: Only God is good. No one else is.

es.L: Nadie [es] bueno sino uno: Dios.
es.B: Nadie es bueno sino solo Dios.
es.R: Solo Dios es bueno. Nadie más lo es.

fr.L: Nul [n’est] bon sinon un seul : Dieu.
fr.B: Personne n’est bon, sinon Dieu seul.
fr.R: Dieu seul est bon. Personne d’autre ne l’est.

sw.L: Hakuna aliye mwema isipokuwa mmoja, Mungu.
sw.B: Hakuna aliye mwema ila Mungu peke yake.
sw.R: Mungu peke yake ndiye mwema. Hakuna mwingine aliye mwema.

vi.L: Không ai [là] nhân lành ngoại trừ một [Đấng], là Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Không ai nhân lành ngoại trừ một mình Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Chỉ có Đức Chúa Trời là tốt lành. Không có ai khác cả.

ko.L: 하나님 한 분 외에는 아무도 선하지 않다.
ko.B: 하나님 한 분 말고는 선한 이가 아무도 없다.
ko.R: 오직 하나님만 선하시다. 다른 누구도 선하지 않다.

pt.L: Ninguém [é] bom, a não ser um só: Deus.
pt.B: Ninguém é bom, a não ser Deus somente.
pt.R: Só Deus é bom. Ninguém mais é.

am.L: ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር መልካም [የሆነ] ማንም የለም።
am.B: ከእግዚአብሔር ብቻ በቀር መልካም የሆነ ማንም የለም።
am.R: መልካም የሆነው እግዚአብሔር ብቻ ነው። ሌላ ማንም የለም።

ru.L: Никто не добр, кроме одного — Бога.
ru.B: Никто не добр, кроме одного Бога.
ru.R: Только Бог добрый. Больше никто.

hi.L: कोई भला नहीं, केवल एक, [अर्थात्] परमेश्वर।
hi.B: परमेश्वर को छोड़ कोई भला नहीं है।
hi.R: केवल परमेश्वर भले हैं। और कोई भला नहीं है।

uk.L: Ніхто не добрий, крім одного — Бога.
uk.B: Ніхто не добрий, тільки один Бог.
uk.R: Добрий тільки Бог. Більше ніхто.

ja.L: ただ一人、神のほかには、善い者はだれもいない。
ja.B: 神おひとりのほかに、善い者はだれもいない。
ja.R: 善いのは神だけだ。ほかにはだれもいない。

decisions.choice: except one, God: an echo of Israel's confession that God is one
decisions.reason: The words recall Deuteronomy 6:4, "the LORD is one". Goodness in the full sense belongs to God (Psalm 106:1).

decisions.choice: God alone
decisions.reason: The word "one" here means only one; Balanced says "alone".

decisions.choice: Only God is good.
alternatives: No one is good except God
decisions.reason: Readable states the positive first.

decisions.choice: "하나님 한 분" (L, B); "오직 하나님만" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Mark 10:18: "한 분" keeps the word "one" that echoes Israel's confession (meaning decision).

source.text: τὰς ἐντολὰς οἶδας· Μὴ μοιχεύσῃς, Μὴ φονεύσῃς, Μὴ κλέψῃς, Μὴ ψευδομαρτυρήσῃς, Τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα.

records.literal_gloss: The commandments you know: Not you shall commit adultery, not you shall murder, not you shall steal, not you shall bear false witness, honor the father of you and the mother.

en.L: You know the commandments: 'Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and mother.'"
en.B: You know the commandments: 'Do not commit adultery. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not give false testimony. Honor your father and your mother.'"
en.R: You know what God's commandments say: 'Do not be unfaithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not lie about others in court. Honor your father and mother.'"

es.L: Conoces los mandamientos: “No cometas adulterio, no mates, no robes, no des falso testimonio, honra a tu padre y a la madre”».
es.B: Ya conoces los mandamientos: “No cometas adulterio. No mates. No robes. No des falso testimonio. Honra a tu padre y a tu madre”».
es.R: Tú sabes lo que dicen los mandamientos de Dios: “No seas infiel en tu matrimonio. No mates. No robes. No mientas contra otras personas en un juicio. Honra a tu padre y a tu madre”».

fr.L: Tu connais les commandements : “Ne commets pas d’adultère, ne commets pas de meurtre, ne vole pas, ne porte pas de faux témoignage, honore ton père et ta mère.” »
fr.B: Tu connais les commandements : “Ne commets pas d’adultère. Ne commets pas de meurtre. Ne vole pas. Ne fais pas de faux témoignage. Honore ton père et ta mère.” »
fr.R: Tu sais ce que disent les commandements de Dieu : “Ne trompe pas ton mari ou ta femme. Ne tue personne. Ne vole pas. Ne mens pas contre les autres devant un tribunal. Respecte ton père et ta mère.” »

sw.L: Unazijua amri: 'Usizini, usiue, usiibe, usitoe ushahidi wa uongo, waheshimu baba yako na mama.'"
sw.B: Unazijua amri: 'Usizini. Usiue. Usiibe. Usitoe ushahidi wa uongo. Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako.'"
sw.R: Unajua yale ambayo amri za Mungu zinasema: 'Usikose uaminifu katika ndoa. Usiue. Usiibe. Usiseme uongo juu ya wengine mahakamani. Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako.'"

vi.L: Ông biết các điều răn: 'Chớ ngoại tình, chớ giết người, chớ trộm cắp, chớ làm chứng dối, hãy hiếu kính cha mẹ ông.'"
vi.B: Ông biết các điều răn rồi: 'Đừng ngoại tình. Đừng giết người. Đừng trộm cắp. Đừng làm chứng dối. Hãy hiếu kính cha mẹ.'"
vi.R: Ông biết những điều răn của Đức Chúa Trời: 'Đừng ngoại tình. Đừng giết người. Đừng trộm cắp. Đừng nói dối để hại người khác trước tòa. Hãy tôn trọng cha mẹ mình.'"

ko.L: 너는 계명들을 안다. '간음하지 마라, 살인하지 마라, 도둑질하지 마라, 거짓 증언하지 마라, 네 아버지와 어머니를 공경하여라.'"
ko.B: 너는 계명을 알고 있다. '간음하지 마라. 살인하지 마라. 도둑질하지 마라. 거짓으로 증언하지 마라. 네 아버지와 어머니를 공경하여라.'"
ko.R: 너는 하나님의 계명을 알고 있다. '간음하지 마라. 사람을 죽이지 마라. 도둑질하지 마라. 재판에서 남에 대해 거짓말하지 마라. 네 아버지와 어머니를 존경하여라.'"

pt.L: Você conhece os mandamentos: 'Não cometas adultério, não mates, não furtes, não dês falso testemunho, honra o teu pai e a mãe.'"
pt.B: Você conhece os mandamentos: 'Não cometerás adultério. Não matarás. Não furtarás. Não darás falso testemunho. Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe.'"
pt.R: Você sabe o que dizem os mandamentos de Deus: 'Não sejas infiel no casamento. Não mates. Não roubes. Não mintas sobre os outros no tribunal. Honra o teu pai e a tua mãe.'"

am.L: ትእዛዛትን ታውቃለህ፤ “አታመንዝር፤ አትግደል፤ አትስረቅ፤ በሐሰት አትመስክር፤ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር።”»
am.B: ትእዛዛትን ታውቃቸዋለህ፤ “አታመንዝር። አትግደል። አትስረቅ። በሐሰት አትመስክር። አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር።”»
am.R: የእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዛት የሚሉትን ታውቃለህ፤ “አታመንዝር። ሰው አትግደል። አትስረቅ። በፍርድ ቤት በሌሎች ላይ በሐሰት አትመስክር። አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር።”»

ru.L: Заповеди знаешь: “Не прелюбодействуй, не убивай, не кради, не лжесвидетельствуй, почитай своего отца и мать.”»
ru.B: Ты знаешь заповеди: “Не прелюбодействуй. Не убивай. Не кради. Не давай ложных показаний. Почитай отца и мать.”»
ru.R: Ты знаешь, что велит Бог: “Не изменяй в браке. Никого не убивай. Не кради. Не лги о других людях в суде. Уважай отца и мать.”»

hi.L: तुम आज्ञाओं को जानते हो: 'व्यभिचार न करना, हत्या न करना, चोरी न करना, झूठी गवाही न देना, अपने पिता और माता का सम्मान करना।'"
hi.B: तुम आज्ञाओं को जानते हो: 'व्यभिचार मत करो। हत्या मत करो। चोरी मत करो। झूठी गवाही मत दो। अपने पिता और अपनी माता का सम्मान करो।'"
hi.R: तुम जानते हो कि परमेश्वर की आज्ञाएँ क्या कहती हैं: 'विवाह में विश्वासघात मत करो। किसी की हत्या मत करो। चोरी मत करो। अदालत में दूसरों के बारे में झूठ मत बोलो। अपने पिता और माता का आदर करो।'"

uk.L: Заповіді знаєш: “Не чини перелюбу, не вбивай, не кради, не свідчи неправдиво, шануй свого батька і матір.”»
uk.B: Ти знаєш заповіді: “Не чини перелюбу. Не вбивай. Не кради. Не давай неправдивого свідчення. Шануй свого батька й свою матір.”»
uk.R: Ти знаєш, що кажуть Божі заповіді: “Не зраджуй у шлюбі. Не вбивай. Не кради. Не бреши про інших у суді. Шануй батька й матір.”»

ja.L: あなたは戒めを知っている。『姦淫してはならない。殺してはならない。盗んではならない。偽りの証言をしてはならない。あなたの父と母を敬いなさい。』」
ja.B: 戒めはあなたも知っているとおりだ。『姦淫してはならない。人を殺してはならない。盗んではならない。偽りの証言をしてはならない。父と母を敬いなさい。』」
ja.R: あなたは神のおきてを知っている。『姦淫してはいけない。人を殺してはいけない。盗んではいけない。裁判で人についてうそを言ってはいけない。父と母を大切にしなさい。』」

decisions.choice: the commandments: from the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes the commandments about one's neighbor from Exodus 20:12-16 and Deuteronomy 5:16-20. Adultery comes before murder, as in some Greek copies of the Old Testament and in Romans 13:9. He does not quote the commandment against coveting, or the commands about God, which the next verses test (18:22).

decisions.choice: bear false witness: give false evidence against someone
decisions.reason: The commandment is about testimony in court (Deuteronomy 19:16-19), though it came to stand for all lying about others.

decisions.choice: do not commit adultery ...: prohibitions
decisions.reason: The form gives commands.

decisions.choice: be unfaithful in marriage; lie about others in court
decisions.reason: Readable explains the two less familiar terms.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks inside Jesus' words; the speech closes here
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes the law inside his speech.

decisions.choice: "Chớ" (L); "Đừng" (B, R) for the commandments' "Do not"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 10:19: "Chớ" has the weight of a law; "Đừng" is the everyday word.

decisions.choice: Luke's order, adultery first; the wording of the Korean Mark 10:19
decisions.reason: The same modern imperatives as Mark 10:19 in Korean; Luke lists adultery before murder, and Korean keeps his order.

decisions.choice: Não cometas ... honra (L); Não cometerás ... Honra (B); Não sejas ... Honra (R): God's "tu"
decisions.reason: The commandments are God's words to Israel and keep God's "tu" at every level (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4), though Jesus speaks to the man with "você". As in Mark 10:19, Literal follows the Greek prohibitions with the "tu" subjunctive, Balanced uses the familiar future of the Law, and Readable the plain "tu" imperative.

decisions.choice: negative commands ("አታመንዝር", "አትግደል") in Luke's order
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 19:18, the Amharic negative command is how the commandments are said; Luke names adultery first, and the order is kept. Readable keeps "አታመንዝር", which is already plain Amharic.

decisions.choice: adultery first, then murder
decisions.reason: The commandments keep the wording of Mark 10:19, but in Luke's order, which puts adultery first; Luke also has no "do not defraud".

decisions.choice: the commandments in the wording of Mark 10:19, in Luke's order
alternatives: "結婚の約束を破ってはいけない" (R)
decisions.reason: Each commandment keeps the Japanese of Mark 10:19; Luke puts adultery first (m1). Readable keeps "姦淫" as Mark's Readable does, and explains false witness as lying in court.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Ταῦτα πάντα ἐφύλαξα ἐκ νεότητος μου.

records.literal_gloss: And he said, These all have I kept from [the] youth.

en.L: And he said, "All these I have kept from [my] youth."
en.B: The man replied, "I have kept every one of these from my youth."
en.R: The man said, "I have obeyed all these commandments since I was young."

es.L: Y él dijo: «Todo esto lo he guardado desde mi juventud».
es.B: «Todo eso lo he cumplido desde mi juventud», respondió el hombre.
es.R: El hombre dijo: «Yo he obedecido todos esos mandamientos desde que era joven».

fr.L: Et il dit : « Tout cela, je l’ai gardé depuis ma jeunesse. »
fr.B: L’homme répondit : « J’ai observé chacun de ces commandements depuis ma jeunesse. »
fr.R: L’homme a dit : « J’obéis à tous ces commandements depuis que je suis jeune. »

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Haya yote nimeyashika tangu ujana wangu."
sw.B: Yule mtu alijibu, "Nimezishika amri hizi zote tangu ujana wangu."
sw.R: Yule mtu alisema, "Nimezitii amri hizo zote tangu nilipokuwa kijana."

vi.L: Người ấy nói: "Tôi đã giữ tất cả những điều này từ thuở nhỏ."
vi.B: Người ấy đáp: "Tôi đã vâng giữ tất cả những điều ấy từ khi còn trẻ."
vi.R: Người ấy nói: "Tôi đã vâng giữ tất cả những điều răn ấy từ khi còn trẻ."

ko.L: 그러자 그가 말했다. "저는 이 모든 것을 어려서부터 지켜 왔습니다."
ko.B: 그 사람이 대답했다. "저는 어렸을 때부터 이 모든 것을 지켜 왔습니다."
ko.R: 그 사람이 말했다. "저는 어릴 때부터 이 계명들을 다 지켜 왔습니다."

pt.L: E ele disse: "Tudo isso eu tenho guardado desde a minha juventude."
pt.B: O homem respondeu: "Eu tenho obedecido a todos eles desde a minha juventude."
pt.R: O homem disse: "Eu obedeço a todos esses mandamentos desde que era jovem."

am.L: እርሱም፦ «ይህን ሁሉ ከወጣትነቴ ጀምሮ ጠብቄአለሁ» አለ።
am.B: ሰውየውም «እነዚህን ሁሉ ከወጣትነቴ ጀምሮ ጠብቄአለሁ» ብሎ መለሰ።
am.R: ሰውየውም «እነዚህን ትእዛዛት ሁሉ ከልጅነቴ ጀምሮ ጠብቄአለሁ» አለ።

ru.L: Он же сказал: «Всё это я соблюдал от юности.»
ru.B: Тот ответил: «Всё это я исполнял с юных лет.»
ru.R: Человек сказал: «Я исполнял все эти заповеди с тех пор, как был молодым.»

hi.L: उसने कहा, "ये सब मैं [अपनी] जवानी से मानता आया हूँ।"
hi.B: उस आदमी ने उत्तर दिया, "मैं लड़कपन से इन सब का पालन करता आया हूँ।"
hi.R: उस आदमी ने कहा, "मैं जवानी से इन सब आज्ञाओं का पालन करता आया हूँ।"

uk.L: Він же сказав: «Усе це я зберіг змолоду.»
uk.B: Той відповів: «Усе це я виконую змалку.»
uk.R: Чоловік сказав: «Я виконував усі ці заповіді відтоді, як був молодим.»

ja.L: すると彼は言った。「これらはみな、若い時から守ってきました。」
ja.B: その人は答えた。「そういうことはみな、子どものころから守ってきました。」
ja.R: その人は言いました。「そのおきては、若いころからみな守ってきました。」

decisions.choice: kept: obeyed, guarded
decisions.reason: The verb means to guard or keep a command. The man means he has lived by them.

decisions.choice: from youth: since he became responsible for keeping the law
decisions.reason: A Jewish boy was taught the law from childhood and held responsible for keeping it as he grew up.

decisions.choice: The man
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker.

decisions.choice: the ruler speaks politely to Jesus ("守ってきました")
decisions.reason: As in Mark 10:20: a man who comes to Jesus as a teacher speaks politely.

source.text: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἔτι ἕν σοι λείπει· πάντα ὅσα ἔχεις πώλησον καὶ διάδος πτωχοῖς, καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι.

records.literal_gloss: Having heard then Jesus said to him, Yet one thing to you is lacking; all as much as you have sell and distribute to [the] poor, and you will have treasure in [the] heavens, and come follow me.

en.L: And having heard [this], Jesus said to him, "One thing is still lacking for you: sell all that you have and distribute [it] to [the] poor, and you will have treasure in [the] heavens; and come, follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: Hearing this, Jesus told him, "You are still missing one thing. Sell all your possessions and hand out the money to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven. After that, come and follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: When Jesus heard this, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "There is one more thing you need to do. Sell everything you own. Give the money to poor people. Then you will have treasure in heaven. After that, come and follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: Y al oír[lo], Jesús le dijo: «Todavía te falta una cosa: todo cuanto tienes véndelo y repárte[lo] a [los] pobres, y tendrás un tesoro en [los] cielos; y ven, sígueme».
es.B: Al oír esto, Jesús le dijo: «Todavía te falta una cosa. Vende todo lo que posees y reparte el dinero entre los pobres. Así tendrás un tesoro en el cielo. Después, ven y sígueme».
es.R: Cuando Jesús oyó esto, le dijo: «Hay una cosa más que tienes que hacer. Vende todo lo que tienes. Da el dinero a los pobres. Así tendrás un tesoro en el cielo. Después, ven y sígueme».

fr.L: Et ayant entendu [cela], Jésus lui dit : « Une chose encore te manque : vends tout ce que tu as et distribue[-le] aux pauvres, et tu auras un trésor dans les cieux ; puis viens, suis-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.B: En entendant cela, Jésus lui dit : « Il te manque encore une chose. Vends tous tes biens et distribue l’argent aux pauvres. Alors tu auras un trésor dans le ciel. Ensuite, viens et suis-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.R: Quand Jésus a entendu cela, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit : « Il te reste encore une chose à faire. Vends tout ce que tu possèdes. Donne l’argent aux pauvres. Alors tu auras un trésor dans le ciel. Ensuite, viens et suis-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »

sw.L: Naye Yesu aliposikia [hayo], akamwambia, "Bado kitu kimoja kinakupungukia: kila ulicho nacho kiuze, na uwagawanyie maskini, na utakuwa na hazina katika mbingu; na njoo, unifuate."
sw.B: Yesu aliposikia hayo, alimwambia, "Bado unakosa jambo moja. Uza mali yako yote, uwagawie maskini fedha hizo. Ndipo utakuwa na hazina mbinguni. Baada ya hapo, njoo unifuate."
sw.R: Yesu aliposikia hayo, alimwambia, "Kuna jambo moja zaidi unalopaswa kufanya. Uza kila kitu ulicho nacho. Wape maskini fedha hizo. Hapo utakuwa na hazina mbinguni. Baada ya hapo, njoo unifuate."

vi.L: Nghe [vậy], Đức Giê-xu nói với ông: "Ông còn thiếu một điều: hãy bán tất cả những gì ông có và phân phát cho người nghèo, thì ông sẽ có kho báu trên trời; rồi hãy đến, theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Nghe vậy, Đức Giê-xu bảo ông: "Ông còn thiếu một điều. Hãy bán hết tài sản của ông và phân phát tiền cho người nghèo, rồi ông sẽ có kho báu trên trời. Sau đó, hãy đến và theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: Khi Đức Giê-xu nghe vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Ông còn phải làm một điều nữa. Hãy bán hết mọi thứ ông có. Hãy đem tiền cho những người nghèo. Như vậy ông sẽ có của cải trên trời. Rồi hãy đến và đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: 예수께서 [이 말을] 들으시고 그에게 말씀하셨다. "네게 아직 한 가지가 부족하다. 네가 가진 것을 다 팔아 가난한 사람들에게 나누어 주어라. 그러면 네가 하늘에서 보물을 가지게 될 것이다. 그리고 와서 나를 따라라."
ko.B: 예수께서 이 말을 들으시고 그에게 말씀하셨다. "너에게 아직 부족한 것이 하나 있다. 네가 가진 것을 모두 팔아 그 돈을 가난한 사람들에게 나누어 주어라. 그러면 하늘에서 보물을 가지게 될 것이다. 그러고 나서 와서 나를 따라라."
ko.R: 예수께서 이 말을 들으시고 말씀하셨다. "너에게 아직 해야 할 일이 하나 있다. 네가 가진 것을 다 팔아라. 그 돈을 가난한 사람들에게 주어라. 그러면 하늘에 재물을 쌓게 될 것이다. 그리고 와서 나를 따라라."

pt.L: E, ouvindo [isso], Jesus lhe disse: "Ainda lhe falta uma coisa: venda tudo o que você tem e distribua aos pobres, e você terá um tesouro nos céus; e venha, siga-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
pt.B: Ao ouvir isso, Jesus lhe disse: "Ainda falta uma coisa para você. Venda tudo o que você possui e reparta o dinheiro entre os pobres. Então você terá um tesouro no céu. Depois disso, venha e siga-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
