uk.R: «Що ти хочеш, щоб {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} для тебе зробив?»

ja.L: 「あなたのために、わたしに何をしてほしいのか？」
ja.B: 「わたしに何をしてほしいのか？」
ja.R: 「わたしに何をしてほしいのか？」

decisions.choice: what do you want me to do for you: Jesus invites the man to say what he asks
decisions.reason: Jesus can see that the man is blind. He asks him to put his request and his trust into words.

decisions.choice: "anh" when Jesus speaks to the blind man
decisions.reason: As Jesus speaks to Bartimaeus in Mark 10:51: the ordinary respectful word for a grown man of no particular rank.

decisions.choice: The same question as the Korean Mark 10:51
decisions.reason: The Greek question is the same as in Mark, so Korean keeps the same words.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} for the English {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}
decisions.reason: Ukrainian says "що ти хочеш, щоб я зробив", so the span falls on "я", the subject of the clause, where English has the object "me".

decisions.choice: "あなたのために" left out (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 10:51: Japanese "……してほしいのか" already says the deed is for the one asked, so Balanced and Readable leave "for you" unsaid.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Κύριε, ἵνα ἀναβλέψω.

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Lord, that I might receive sight.

en.L: And he said, "Lord, that I may receive sight."
en.B: He answered, "Lord, I want to see again."
en.R: The man answered, "Lord, I want to be able to see again."

es.L: Y él dijo: «Señor, que yo recobre la vista».
es.B: Él respondió: «Señor, quiero volver a ver».
es.R: El hombre respondió: «Señor, quiero poder ver otra vez».

sw.B: Alijibu, "Bwana, nataka kuona tena."
sw.R: Yule mtu alijibu, "Bwana, nataka kuweza kuona tena."

vi.B: Anh thưa: "Lạy Chúa, xin cho tôi được thấy lại."
vi.R: Người mù trả lời: "Lạy Chúa, tôi muốn được nhìn thấy lại."

ko.L: 그가 말했다. "주님, 다시 보게 [해 주십시오]."
ko.B: 그가 대답했다. "주님, 다시 보고 싶습니다."
ko.R: 그 사람이 대답했다. "주님, 다시 볼 수 있게 해 주십시오."

pt.B: Ele respondeu: "Senhor, eu quero voltar a enxergar."
pt.R: O homem respondeu: "Senhor, eu quero poder enxergar de novo."

am.L: እርሱም፦ «ጌታ ሆይ፣ ማየት እንድችል [እፈልጋለሁ]» አለ።
am.B: እርሱም «ጌታ ሆይ፣ እንደ ገና ማየት እፈልጋለሁ» ብሎ መለሰ።
am.R: ሰውየውም «ጌታ ሆይ፣ እንደ ገና ማየት እንድችል እፈልጋለሁ» ብሎ መለሰ።

ru.L: Он же сказал: «Господи, чтобы мне прозреть.»
ru.B: Он ответил: «Господи, я хочу снова видеть.»
ru.R: Человек ответил: «Господи, я хочу снова стать зрячим.»

hi.L: उसने कहा, "हे प्रभु, [यह] कि मैं फिर से देखने लगूँ।"
hi.B: उसने उत्तर दिया, "हे प्रभु, मैं फिर से देखना चाहता हूँ।"
hi.R: उस आदमी ने उत्तर दिया, "हे प्रभु, मैं चाहता हूँ कि फिर से देख सकूँ।"

uk.L: Він же сказав: «Господи, щоб я прозрів.»
uk.B: Він відповів: «Господи, я хочу знову бачити.»
uk.R: Чоловік відповів: «Господи, я хочу знову бачити.»

ja.L: その人は言った。「主よ、再び見えるように[なりたいのです]。」
ja.B: その人は答えた。「主よ、また見えるようになりたいのです。」
ja.R: その人は答えました。「主よ、もう一度見えるようになりたいのです。」

decisions.choice: Lord: a title of respect, here given to the Son of David
decisions.reason: The word can be a polite "sir", but this man has called Jesus the Son of David (18:38-39).

decisions.choice: receive sight: see again, or see
alternatives: see for the first time only
decisions.reason: The verb means to look up, and so to regain sight. It may mean he had once seen.

decisions.choice: I want to see again
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say the request as a natural sentence.

decisions.choice: Señor
decisions.reason: The blind man uses the polite address, but he gives it to the one he has just called Son of David (meaning decision m1), so it is written with a capital, as the English "Lord" is.

decisions.choice: Bwana
decisions.reason: The blind man uses the polite address, but he gives it to the one he has just called Son of David (meaning decision m1), so it is written with a capital, as the English "Lord" is.

decisions.choice: "Lạy Chúa" with "tôi"
decisions.reason: A title of respect given to the Son of David (meaning decision); as with the leper of Luke 5:12, "Chúa" keeps the trust in his power, while the man, not yet a follower, still says "tôi".

decisions.choice: "주님" for kyrie; [해 주십시오] (L)
decisions.reason: A title of respect (meaning decision), "주님" as in the Korean Luke 5:12; the Greek leaves the main verb out, and Literal brackets the one Korean needs, as in the Korean Mark 10:51.

decisions.choice: [እፈልጋለሁ] (I want)
decisions.reason: The Greek has only a clause of purpose, "that I may see"; Amharic needs a main verb, as in Matthew 20:33.

decisions.choice: "主よ" at every level
decisions.reason: The Gospel terms give "先生" at Balanced and Readable for a stranger's "Lord", but this man has twice called Jesus the Son of David, and the meaning decision (m1) reads the word as more than a polite "sir", as the English keeps "Lord" at every level.

source.text: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἀνάβλεψον· ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε.

records.literal_gloss: And Jesus said to him, Receive sight; the faith of you has healed you.

en.L: And Jesus said to him, "Receive your sight; your faith has saved you."
en.B: Jesus told him, "See again. Your faith has made you well."
en.R: Jesus said to him, "Then see! Your faith has made you well and saved you."

es.L: Y Jesús le dijo: «Recobra la vista; tu fe te ha salvado».
es.B: Jesús le dijo: «Vuelve a ver. Tu fe te ha sanado».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «¡Recibe la vista! Tu fe te ha sanado y te ha salvado».

fr.L: Et Jésus lui dit : « Recouvre la vue ; ta foi t’a sauvé. »
fr.B: Jésus lui dit : « Vois de nouveau. Ta foi t’a guéri. »
fr.R: Jésus lui a dit : « Alors, vois ! Ta foi t’a guéri et sauvé. »

sw.L: Naye Yesu akamwambia, "Pata kuona; imani yako imekuokoa."
sw.B: Yesu alimwambia, "Ona tena. Imani yako imekuponya."
sw.R: Yesu alimwambia, "Basi, ona! Imani yako imekuponya na kukuokoa."

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu nói với anh: "Hãy thấy lại; đức tin của anh đã cứu anh."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu bảo anh: "Hãy thấy lại đi. Đức tin của anh đã chữa lành anh."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với anh: "Vậy thì hãy nhìn thấy! Đức tin của anh đã chữa lành anh và cứu anh."

ko.L: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "다시 보아라. 네 믿음이 너를 구원하였다."
ko.B: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "다시 보아라. 네 믿음이 너를 구원했고 너를 낫게 했다."
ko.R: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "자, 다시 보아라! 네 믿음이 너를 낫게 했고 너를 구원했다."

pt.L: E Jesus lhe disse: "Recupere a vista; a sua fé o salvou."
pt.B: Jesus lhe disse: "Volte a enxergar! A sua fé o curou."
pt.R: Jesus disse a ele: "Então enxergue! A sua fé curou você e salvou você."

am.L: ኢየሱስም፦ «እይ፤ እምነትህ አድኖሃል» አለው።
am.B: ኢየሱስም «እንደ ገና እይ። እምነትህ ፈውሶሃል» አለው።
am.R: ኢየሱስም «እንግዲያውስ እይ! እምነትህ ፈውሶሃል፤ አድኖሃልም» አለው።

ru.L: И Иисус сказал ему: «Прозри; твоя вера спасла тебя.»
ru.B: Иисус сказал ему: «Пусть к тебе вернётся зрение. Твоя вера исцелила тебя.»
ru.R: Иисус сказал ему: «Тогда смотри! Твоя вера исцелила и спасла тебя.»

hi.L: और यीशु ने उससे कहा, "फिर से देखने लगो; तुम्हारे विश्वास ने तुम्हें बचा लिया है।"
hi.B: यीशु ने उससे कहा, "फिर से देखो। तुम्हारे विश्वास ने तुम्हें चंगा कर दिया है।"
hi.R: यीशु ने उससे कहा, "तो देखने लगो! तुम्हारे विश्वास ने तुम्हें चंगा कर दिया है और बचा लिया है।"

uk.L: І Ісус сказав йому: «Прозри; твоя віра спасла тебе.»
uk.B: Ісус сказав йому: «Бач знову. Твоя віра зцілила тебе.»
uk.R: Ісус сказав йому: «То бач! Твоя віра зцілила тебе й урятувала.»

ja.L: そこでイエスは彼に言われた。「見えるようになれ。あなたの信仰があなたを救った。」
ja.B: イエスは言われた。「見えるようになれ。あなたの信仰があなたを癒やしたのだ。」
ja.R: イエスはその人に言われました。「さあ、見えるようになれ！あなたの信仰があなたを治し、救ったのだ。」

decisions.choice: has saved you: has made you well, and more than that, has rescued you
decisions.reason: The verb means to save or rescue, and in healings to make well. Luke uses the same words for the woman whose sins were forgiven (7:50), the woman healed by touching Jesus (8:48), and the Samaritan (17:19). The man goes on to follow Jesus (18:43).

decisions.choice: your faith: his trust that Jesus, the Son of David, could and would heal him
decisions.reason: His faith showed in his cry and in his refusal to be silenced.

decisions.choice: receive sight: a command that heals
decisions.reason: Jesus heals by his word.

decisions.choice: made you well (B); made you well and saved you (R)
decisions.reason: As in 8:48 and 17:19: Literal keeps "saved", Balanced says what happened to his body, and Readable uses both words.

decisions.choice: "đã cứu anh" (L); "đã chữa lành anh" (B); "đã chữa lành anh và cứu anh" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 17:19: made well and, more than that, rescued (meaning decision, footnoted).

decisions.choice: "믿음"; "구원하다" with "낫게 하다" added at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 17:19 and Mark 10:52: the verb means both made well and saved (meaning decision, footnoted).

decisions.choice: "बचा लिया है" (L); "चंगा कर दिया है" (B); both (R)
decisions.reason: As in 17:19: Literal keeps "saved", Balanced says what happened to his body, and Readable uses both (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "見えるようになれ"
decisions.reason: A command that heals (m3), in the form of "清くなれ" at 5:13.

decisions.choice: "救った" (L); "癒やした" (B); "治し、救った" (R)
decisions.reason: As at 17:19 and in Mark 10:52.

source.text: καὶ παραχρῆμα ἀνέβλεψεν, καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ δοξάζων τὸν θεόν.

records.literal_gloss: And immediately he received sight, and began following him glorifying God.

en.L: And immediately he received sight, and began following {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, glorifying God.
en.B: At once he could see, and he followed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, giving glory to God.
en.R: Right away the man could see again. He followed Jesus, giving glory to God.

es.L: Y al instante recobró la vista, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} seguía glorificando a Dios.
es.B: En ese mismo momento pudo ver, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} siguió dando gloria a Dios.
es.R: Enseguida el hombre pudo ver otra vez. Siguió a Jesús, dando gloria a Dios.

fr.L: Et aussitôt il recouvra la vue, et il {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivait en glorifiant Dieu.
fr.B: À l’instant même, il put voir, et il {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivit en rendant gloire à Dieu.
fr.R: Tout de suite, l’homme a pu voir de nouveau. Il a suivi Jésus en rendant gloire à Dieu.

sw.L: Na mara akapata kuona, akaanza kumfuata, akimtukuza Mungu.
sw.B: Mara moja aliweza kuona, akamfuata, akimpa Mungu utukufu.
sw.R: Mara hiyo yule mtu aliweza kuona tena. Akamfuata Yesu, akimtukuza Mungu.

vi.L: Lập tức anh thấy lại được, và đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Ngay lúc đó anh thấy được, và anh đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Ngay lập tức người ấy nhìn thấy lại được. Anh đi theo Đức Giê-xu và tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그러자 그는 곧 다시 보게 되었고, 하나님께 영광을 돌리며 그분을 따라갔다.
ko.B: 그러자 곧바로 그는 다시 보게 되었고, 하나님께 영광을 돌리며 예수를 따라갔다.
ko.R: 그 사람은 바로 다시 볼 수 있게 되었다. 그리고 하나님께 영광을 돌리며 예수를 따라갔다.

pt.L: E imediatamente ele recuperou a vista e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} seguia, glorificando a Deus.
pt.B: Na mesma hora ele passou a enxergar e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} seguiu, dando glória a Deus.
pt.R: Na mesma hora o homem voltou a enxergar. Ele seguiu Jesus, dando glória a Deus.

am.L: ወዲያውም አየ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም እያከበረ ይከተለው ጀመር።
am.B: ወዲያውም ማየት ቻለ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም እያከበረ ተከተለው።
am.R: ሰውየው ወዲያውኑ እንደ ገና ማየት ቻለ። እግዚአብሔርን እያከበረ ኢየሱስን ተከተለው።

ru.L: И тотчас он прозрел и следовал за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, прославляя Бога.
ru.B: Он сразу стал видеть и пошёл за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, прославляя Бога.
ru.R: Человек сразу снова стал видеть. Он пошёл за Иисусом, прославляя Бога.

hi.L: और वह तुरंत देखने लगा, और परमेश्वर की महिमा करता हुआ उनके पीछे हो लिया।
hi.B: उसी पल वह देखने लगा, और परमेश्वर की महिमा करता हुआ उनके पीछे चल पड़ा।
hi.R: उसी समय वह आदमी फिर से देखने लगा। वह परमेश्वर की महिमा करता हुआ यीशु के पीछे चल पड़ा।

uk.L: І зараз же він прозрів і пішов за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, прославляючи Бога.
uk.B: Тієї ж миті він став бачити й пішов за {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, віддаючи славу Богові.
uk.R: Чоловік відразу знову став бачити. Він пішов за Ісусом і прославляв Бога.

ja.L: するとたちどころに彼は見えるようになり、神をあがめながらイエスに従って行った。
ja.B: その人はたちまち見えるようになり、神をあがめながらイエスに従って行った。
ja.R: すぐに、その人は目が見えるようになりました。そして、神をほめたたえながら、イエスについて行きました。

decisions.choice: following him: going with Jesus, as a disciple does
decisions.reason: Unlike the rich ruler (18:22-23), the man who has nothing follows Jesus at once.

decisions.choice: glorifying God: praising God for what he had done
decisions.reason: As in 5:25 and 17:15.

decisions.choice: "Lập tức" (L) for "immediately"
decisions.reason: The settled Literal word for this adverb in Mark and Matthew; Balanced and Readable use "ngay lúc đó", "ngay lập tức".

decisions.choice: "곧" (L), "곧바로" (B), "바로" (R) for parachrema
decisions.reason: The words settled for "immediately" in the Korean Gospels, used for Luke's word as for euthys in Mark.

source.text: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἰδὼν ἔδωκεν αἶνον τῷ θεῷ.

records.literal_gloss: And all the people, having seen [it], gave praise to God.

en.L: And all the people, having seen [it], gave praise to God.
en.B: All the people saw what happened, and they gave praise to God.
en.R: All the people who saw this praised God too.

es.L: Y todo el pueblo, al ver[lo], dio alabanza a Dios.
es.B: Todo el pueblo, al ver lo sucedido, alabó a Dios.
es.R: Toda la gente que vio esto también alabó a Dios.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple, ayant vu [cela], donna louange à Dieu.
fr.B: Tout le peuple vit ce qui s’était passé et rendit louange à Dieu.
fr.R: Tous les gens qui avaient vu cela ont aussi loué Dieu.

sw.L: Na watu wote, walipoona, wakatoa sifa kwa Mungu.
sw.B: Watu wote walipoona yaliyotokea, walimsifu Mungu.
sw.R: Watu wote walioona jambo hilo nao walimsifu Mungu.

vi.L: Và toàn dân, thấy [vậy], đều ngợi khen Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Cả dân chúng thấy điều đã xảy ra, đều ngợi khen Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Mọi người thấy việc ấy cũng ngợi khen Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 온 백성이 [그것을] 보고 하나님께 찬양을 드렸다.
ko.B: 온 백성이 이 일을 보고 하나님을 찬양했다.
ko.R: 이 일을 본 사람들도 모두 하나님을 찬양했다.

pt.L: E todo o povo, vendo [isso], deu louvor a Deus.
pt.B: Todo o povo viu o que aconteceu e louvou a Deus.
pt.R: Todas as pessoas que viram isso também louvaram a Deus.

am.L: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አይተው ለእግዚአብሔር ውዳሴ አቀረቡ።
am.B: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ የሆነውን አይተው እግዚአብሔርን አወደሱ።
am.R: ይህን ያዩ ሰዎችም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ።

ru.L: И весь народ, увидев [это], воздал хвалу Богу.
ru.B: Весь народ видел это и воздал хвалу Богу.
ru.R: Все люди, которые видели это, тоже славили Бога.

hi.L: और सब लोगों ने [यह] देखकर परमेश्वर की स्तुति की।
hi.B: सब लोगों ने यह देखा और परमेश्वर की स्तुति की।
hi.R: जिन लोगों ने यह देखा, उन सबने भी परमेश्वर की स्तुति की।

uk.L: І весь народ, побачивши [це], віддав хвалу Богові.
uk.B: Усі люди бачили, що сталося, і хвалили Бога.
uk.R: Усі люди, які бачили це, теж прославляли Бога.

ja.L: そして民はみな、[これを]見て、神に賛美をささげた。
ja.B: これを見た民はみな、神を賛美した。
ja.R: これを見た人々もみな、神を賛美しました。

decisions.choice: the people: the crowd, God's people
decisions.reason: Luke often uses this word for the crowds of Israel who heard Jesus gladly (7:16; 19:48).

decisions.choice: praise: words of praise
decisions.reason: This is a different word from "glorifying" in 18:43a, a plain word for praise.

decisions.choice: "백성" (L, B); "사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The people are the crowd as God's people (meaning decision); "백성" carries that, and Readable uses the plain word.

decisions.choice: "賛美" for this word; "あがめる" / "ほめたたえる" for "glorifying" in 18:43a
decisions.reason: Luke uses a different word here (m2), so Japanese keeps the two apart.
